status: All384 complete saved abstracts read; primary followup flags are not drug-efficacy claims.
scope: Fixed SHA256 order, no biology/date/benefit/catalog-alias filter. Original per-record assessments retained with the explicit integration correction below. Full primary papers not implied.

records.title: RNAi library screening reveals Gβ1, Casein Kinase 2 and ICAP-1 as novel regulators of LFA-1-mediated T cell polarity and migration.
records.model: HuT 78 cells and primary human T cells
records.note: RNAi screening and primary-cell followup identify Gβ1, casein kinase 2 and ICAP-1 as regulators of LFA-1-dependent polarity and migration; these are gene perturbation findings.
records.uncertainty: No administered therapeutic rescue described.

records.title: Pan-cancer analysis of DEPDC1 as a candidate prognostic biomarker and associated with immune infiltration.
records.model: Public pan-cancer transcriptomic and clinical datasets
records.note: DEPDC1 expression associates with cell-cycle programs, immune features and survival across cancers. Database correlations nominate a biomarker without testing restoration or treatment.
records.uncertainty: Causal and therapeutic effects are not established.

records.title: Identification of potential core genes in lung cancer and therapeutic traditional Chinese medicine compounds using bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Public lung-cancer expression datasets and compound database
records.note: CDC20, CCNB2 and TOP2A emerge as adverse-prognosis hub genes; database matching nominates paclitaxel, quercetin and rotenone. The abstract describes no administration or efficacy experiment.
records.uncertainty: Therapeutic language exceeds the described computational evidence.

records.title: Breast, Colorectal, and Pancreatic Cancer Mortality With Pathogenic Variants in <i>ATM</i>, <i>CHEK2</i>, or <i>PALB2</i>.
records.model: Genetically tested breast, colorectal and pancreatic cancer registry cohorts
records.note: ATM, CHEK2 and PALB2 pathogenic variants show mortality similar to the tested cancer population. A triple-negative ATM signal weakens under regularization; BRCA and Lynch associations differ.
records.uncertainty: Registry associations do not establish treatment effects.

records.title: A farnesyl-dependent structural role for CENP-E in expansion of the fibrous corona
records.model: Cellular kinetochore studies and comparative genomics
records.note: CENP-E supports fibrous-corona expansion through farnesyl-dependent RZZ-S interaction independently of motor activity; depletion compromises corona function, identifying a separable structural chromosome-segregation mechanism.
records.uncertainty: No drug-mediated restoration or disease-model rescue described.

records.title: Understanding eukaryotic chromosome segregation from a comparative biology perspective.
records.model: Comparative eukaryotic chromosome-segregation literature
records.note: The review argues that diverse segregation strategies across species can reveal conserved functional relationships beyond conventional models. It presents no specific administered intervention or rescue result.
records.uncertainty: Abstract provides no individual experimental efficacy evidence.

records.title: Combined treatment with HMGN1 and anti-CD4 depleting antibody reverses T cell exhaustion and exerts robust anti-tumor effects in mice.
records.model: Colon26 and B16F10 tumor-bearing mice
records.outcome_direction: immune functional restoration and tumor regression
records.note: Combined HMGN1 and CD4 depletion expands effector CD8 cells, reduces exhaustion markers and prolongs antitumor activity, with long-term tumor regression or rejection. This includes reported immune-function rescue beyond tumor killing alone.
records.uncertainty: Combination dependence and transferability beyond these tumor models remain unresolved.

records.title: Widespread DNA hypomethylation and differential gene expression in Turner syndrome.
records.model: Leukocytes from Turner syndrome and karyotypically normal controls
records.note: Turner syndrome leukocytes show widespread hypomethylation, including repetitive elements, and distinct expression patterns. Candidate comorbidity genes are nominated without an intervention.
records.uncertainty: Associations do not establish correction strategies.

records.title: Cryptococcus neoformans employs both PP1 and PP2A phosphatases to silence the spindle checkpoint
records.model: Cryptococcus neoformans
records.outcome_direction: mitotic impairment after disrupted phosphatase recruitment
records.note: Disrupting kinetochore recruitment of PP1 or PP2A-B56 prolongs spindle-checkpoint signaling and causes mitotic defects. Distinct recruitment interfaces support checkpoint silencing in this fungal model.
records.uncertainty: No restoration intervention; conservation of therapeutic effects is untested.

records.title: Short-lived effector CD8 T cells induced by genetically attenuated malaria parasite vaccination express CD11c.
records.model: Vaccinated rodents and infected primary-hepatocyte coculture
records.note: Vaccination induces CD11c-positive short-lived CD8 effectors that express inflammatory and cytotoxic markers and inhibit parasite development in coculture. CD11c is lost as memory develops.
records.uncertainty: This characterizes vaccine-induced effectors rather than rescue of an intrinsic cellular defect.

records.title: LUBAC controls chromosome alignment by targeting CENP-E to attached kinetochores.
records.model: Mitotic kinetochore and chromosome-alignment cell experiments
records.note: LUBAC-mediated linear ubiquitination anchors CENP-E to KNL1 at attached kinetochores, supporting congression and continued alignment. This identifies a functional segregation-maintenance route distinct from unattached-kinetochore targeting.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological augmentation or deficient-model rescue stated.

records.title: Identification of the hub genes related to adipose tissue metabolism of bovine.
records.model: Diet-associated bovine adipose transcriptomes and tissue expression validation
records.note: Network analysis of heifers fed differing energy or protein diets nominates eight lipid-metabolism hubs, with tissue-expression validation. The work does not show a drug effect or correction of muscle dysfunction.
records.uncertainty: Hub-gene causal effects and functional benefit are untested.

records.title: A novel measure of chromosome instability can account for prognostic difference in multiple myeloma.

administered_agents.name: bortezomib
administered_agents.role: historical treatment in a relapsed-patient validation cohort

records.model: Multiple-myeloma genomic and expression cohorts
records.outcome_direction: higher instability associates with poorer survival
records.note: A chromosome-instability event count and derived expression signature predict survival across myeloma cohorts, including bortezomib-treated patients. Treatment exposure validates prognostic association rather than demonstrating drug-mediated instability correction.
records.uncertainty: No comparative treatment efficacy attributable to the signature is described.

records.title: Dynamic phosphorylation of HP1α regulates mitotic progression in human cells.
records.model: Human mitotic cells
records.note: NDR1-dependent hinge phosphorylation of HP1α supports kinetochore localization, Sgo1 binding and mitotic progression; NDR loss causes prometaphase arrest. This supplies a specific chromosome-fidelity regulatory mechanism.
records.uncertainty: No administered activator or restoration in a disease model is reported.

records.title: Cytotoxicity mediated by histone deacetylase inhibitors in cancer cells: mechanisms and potential clinical implications.
records.model: Cancer epigenetic and HDAC-inhibitor literature
records.note: The review covers HDAC expression and mechanisms by which HDAC inhibitors cause antitumor effects. No named administered agent or restorative functional outcome is provided in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: Review-level discussion cannot establish a specific intervention result.

records.title: CDC25B Is a Prognostic Biomarker Associated With Immune Infiltration and Drug Sensitivity in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: HCC public datasets, clinical tissue and HCC-LM3 cells
records.note: CDC25B overexpression associates with adverse HCC features; knockdown reduces the reported proliferation-related cell phenotype. Drug-sensitivity associations are described without named administered treatments or restoration experiments.
records.uncertainty: The abstract uses unclear differentiation wording and does not establish drug causality.

records.title: Definition of the Neurotoxicity-Associated Metabolic Signature Triggered by Berberine and Other Respiratory Chain Inhibitors.
records.model: Neurite-degeneration assay with transcriptomic, metabolic and respiratory measurements
records.note: Berberine, rotenone and MPP inhibit complex I and share oxidative stress, excess NADH and neurodegeneration-associated metabolites even without ATP depletion. Berberine resembles established toxicants, providing material counterevidence to uncomplicated metabolic-benefit claims.
records.uncertainty: Exposure relevance and in vivo risk require primary-source assessment.

records.title: Investigating Germ Cell Transition Genes in Breast Cancer: Exploring the Genesis of Cancer Testis-Associated Markers.
records.model: Breast tumor public datasets and 28 tissue samples
records.note: Reanalysis and tissue validation identify male-germline-associated expression in breast tumors, while single-cell analysis suggests stromal contributions. This profiles tumor heterogeneity without testing interventions.
records.uncertainty: Expression resemblance does not demonstrate germline transition causality.

records.title: Bioinformatics-based screening of key genes for transformation of liver cirrhosis to hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: Cirrhosis and HCC public expression datasets
records.note: Integrated expression and interaction analyses nominate CDKN3, CYP2C9 and LCAT; CDKN3 links to cell-cycle networks and adverse disease features. No experimental treatment or restored function is reported.
records.uncertainty: Correlational hub nomination remains unvalidated as a therapy.

records.title: The Phosphatase Dusp7 Drives Meiotic Resumption and Chromosome Alignment in Mouse Oocytes.
records.model: Mouse oocytes depleted of DUSP7
records.outcome_direction: impaired meiotic entry and chromosome segregation
records.note: DUSP7 depletion lowers Cdk1/cyclin-B activity, delaying or preventing meiotic resumption; entering oocytes misalign chromosomes and reach anaphase prematurely. cPKC dephosphorylation is proposed as the entry mechanism.
records.uncertainty: No specified therapeutic rescue; suggested pathway needs primary mechanistic detail.

records.title: Mosaicism for combined tetrasomy of chromosomes 8 and 18 in a dysmorphic child: a result of failed tetraploidy correction?
records.model: Child with mosaic combined chromosome 8 and 18 tetrasomy
records.outcome_direction: developmental pathology with speculative correction mechanism
records.note: A dysmorphic child has mosaic double tetrasomy detected after standard karyotyping appeared normal. Failed embryonic tetraploidy correction is proposed as its origin, without direct observation of correction.
records.uncertainty: The corrective mechanism is a hypothesis from one case.

records.title: Polo-like kinase 1 inhibition suppresses hepatitis B virus X protein-induced transformation in an in vitro model of liver cancer progression.
records.model: HBV X-expressing immortalized hepatocyte polyploid cultures
records.note: Prolonged culture of X-induced polyploid cells accumulates DNA damage, loses p53 function and transforms; Plk1 inhibition suppresses transformation. The abstract does not say damaged chromosomes or normal-cell function were restored.
records.uncertainty: Inhibition method and specific agent are unspecified.

records.title: Nanotechnology for angiogenesis: opportunities and challenges.
records.model: Nanoparticle angiogenesis literature
records.note: The review surveys nanoparticles for angiogenesis inhibition and tissue-repair stimulation, noting that several preparations stimulate at low dose and inhibit at high dose. This suggests possible regenerative routes needing source-level identification.
records.uncertainty: No specific preparation, dosing or repair effect is established here.

records.title: MAPL loss dysregulates bile and liver metabolism in mice.
records.model: MAPL-knockout mice and primary hepatocytes
records.outcome_direction: metabolic benefits coupled to liver pathology
records.note: MAPL loss improves insulin sensitivity and protects against diet-induced obesity, yet disrupts bile-acid feedback and produces fully penetrant spontaneous HCC. FGF21 induction accompanies a liver stress response.
records.uncertainty: Genetic deletion is not drug treatment; benefits cannot be separated from harms here.

records.title: Identification of differentially expressed genes and biological pathways in bladder cancer.
records.model: Bladder cancer and normal-tissue expression dataset
records.note: Differential expression and network analysis identify cell-cycle hubs and altered matrix/coagulation pathways in bladder cancer. The proposed targets are computational nominations without intervention evidence.
records.uncertainty: Neither restorative function nor treatment efficacy was tested.

records.title: Senescence in the aging process.
records.model: Mammalian senescence and aging literature
records.note: The review describes senescent cells as causal contributors to aging and frames ameliorating their effects as a future challenge. No administered compound or specific functional rescue is given.
records.uncertainty: Broad review framing does not identify a tested lead.

records.title: A direct role of Mad1 in the spindle assembly checkpoint beyond Mad2 kinetochore recruitment.
records.model: Artificial kinetochore recruitment and Mad1 perturbation experiments
records.outcome_direction: engineered recruitment fails to bypass Mad1 requirement
records.note: Even forced C-Mad2 recruitment to kinetochores cannot produce checkpoint arrest without Mad1. Its C-terminal domain supplies an additional function, limiting a simple localization-only checkpoint compensation strategy.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological intervention; details of engineered bypass tests need primary review.

records.title: Uncovering potential genes in colorectal cancer based on integrated and DNA methylation analysis in the gene expression omnibus database.
records.model: Colorectal cancer expression and methylation datasets with in vitro expression validation
records.note: Integrated analyses identify altered expression/methylation and candidate CRC biomarkers; BEST4, SHMT2 and TRIP13 associate with survival. Validation addresses expression rather than therapeutic correction.
records.uncertainty: No administered-agent efficacy or causal rescue is described.

records.title: APC/C: current understanding and future perspectives.
records.model: APC/C regulatory and structural literature
records.note: The review summarizes APC/C activation, inhibition, substrate handling and structural studies governing sister-chromatid separation. The abstract supplies no specific restoration experiment or therapeutic result.
records.uncertainty: Potential regulatory leverage remains unspecified.

records.title: Cell Size Determines the Strength of the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint during Embryonic Development.
records.model: Caenorhabditis elegans embryogenesis with size and ploidy mutants
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint strength varies with kinetochore-to-cytoplasm ratio
records.note: Embryonic checkpoint delays strengthen with successive divisions; altered cell size and ploidy implicate the kinetochore-to-cytoplasm ratio as a major determinant. This provides an in vivo checkpoint-capacity mechanism beyond protein abundance alone.
records.uncertainty: Microtubule-disruption agent is unspecified; no disease rescue is established.

records.title: Hemodynamic and transcriptomic studies suggest early left ventricular dysfunction in a preclinical model of severe mitral regurgitation.
records.model: Rat mitral-leaflet puncture model followed longitudinally
records.note: Induced severe regurgitation causes ventricular dilation and reduced load-independent pump indices before ejection fraction falls. Transcriptomics transition from myocyte and oxidative-stress responses to matrix remodeling.
records.uncertainty: This is injury characterization without a treatment arm.

records.title: DNA double-strand breaks: a potential causative factor for mammalian aging?
records.model: DNA-break repair and premature-aging mouse-model literature
records.note: The review examines double-strand breaks as aging contributors and argues that aging in DSB-repair versus UV-lesion-repair mutants may arise through different mechanisms. No intervention efficacy is reported.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic comparison does not identify a corrective agent.

records.title: Two cases of genetic testing for familial adenomatous polyposis without a family history.
records.model: Two women with clinically diagnosed attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis
records.note: Panel testing differentiates APC-positive disease from an APC-negative case with an uncertain SMAD9 variant. Surgery and unspecified chemotherapy appear in case histories but do not test molecular restoration.
records.uncertainty: No chemotherapy agent is named; SMAD9 causality remains uncertain.

records.title: Mechanisms of pseudosubstrate inhibition of the anaphase promoting complex by Acm1.
records.model: Acm1, Cdh1 and Hsl1 mutational and ubiquitination studies
records.note: Acm1 inhibitory binding requires an A-motif plus destruction/KEN boxes; lysine insertion promotes ubiquitination, whereas lysine removal converts Hsl1 into an APC/C inhibitor. This maps pseudosubstrate behavior.
records.uncertainty: No disease rescue or administered inhibitor is shown.

records.title: Prognostic gene HLA-DMA associated with cell cycle and immune infiltrates in LUAD.
records.model: LUAD datasets, clinical tissue and NSCLC cell lines
records.note: Higher HLA-DMA associates with survival and immune features, while cell experiments suggest proliferation restraint through cell-cycle regulation. Immunotherapy suitability is inferred from associations.
records.uncertainty: No named administered immunotherapy or restoration outcome is provided.

records.title: Spatiotemporal dynamics of Spc105 regulates the assembly of the Drosophila kinetochore.
records.model: Drosophila syncytial embryos and ectopic centrosome localization
records.note: Spc105 nuclear access initiates kinetochore assembly; its C terminus recruits core components and CENP-C when ectopically localized. Localization and component availability are sufficient to reorganize assembly in this model.
records.uncertainty: Ectopic assembly is not proof of functional disease correction.

records.title: Survivin at a glance.
records.model: Survivin/BIRC5 literature
records.note: The review describes survivin structure, expression, partners and roles in division and cell survival, ending with anti-survivin strategies under trial. No individual treatment outcome appears in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: No specific restorative result or administered agent is identified.

records.title: A Quantitative Measurement of Reactive Oxygen Species and Senescence-associated Secretory Phenotype in Normal Human Fibroblasts During Oncogene-induced Senescence.
records.model: H-Ras-induced senescence in normal human fibroblasts
records.note: Protocols quantify intracellular ROS and expression/secretion of senescence-associated factors. They supply measurement methods rather than evidence that a treatment improves senescence or tissue function.
records.uncertainty: Fluorescent assay dye is unnamed and not a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: New Pathogenic Germline Variants in Very Early Onset and Familial Colorectal Cancer Patients.
records.model: 149 familial or very-early-onset colorectal cancer participants
records.note: Gene-panel sequencing identifies pathogenic variants and reclassifies an MSH2 variant; a segregating RPS20 variant remains an interesting candidate. The work concerns inherited risk and diagnostic panel scope.
records.uncertainty: Uncertain variants, including BUB1, are not established intervention targets.

records.title: Chromosomes with delayed replication timing lead to checkpoint activation, delayed recruitment of Aurora B and chromosome instability.
records.model: Cells with delayed-replicating and delayed-condensing chromosomes
records.note: Abnormal chromosomes retain checkpoint signals and INCENP while Aurora B recruitment and H3 phosphorylation lag. These cells also show spindle defects, centrosome amplification and endoreduplication.
records.uncertainty: No intervention reverses delayed replication or instability in the abstract.

records.title: Clinical Diagnosis of Mendelian Disorders Using a Comprehensive Gene-Targeted Panel Test for Next-Generation Sequencing.
records.model: 17 families and 20 patients undergoing targeted sequencing
records.note: A comprehensive targeted gene panel identifies causative mutations in six families, supporting diagnostic use in Mendelian disorders. It provides no treatment or functional rescue experiment.
records.uncertainty: Yield comparisons are study-specific and not therapeutic evidence.

records.title: Bisphenol B Exposure Disrupts Mouse Oocyte Meiotic Maturation in vitro Through Affecting Spindle Assembly and Chromosome Alignment.
records.model: Mouse oocyte maturation in vitro
records.note: Bisphenol B at 150 μM disrupts spindle organization, chromosome alignment and meiotic progression, with DNA damage and altered acetylation/epigenetic marks despite unchanged ROS and ATP.
records.uncertainty: This toxicant experiment does not establish human exposure effects or a treatment lead.

records.title: Genome-wide microarray evidence that 8-cell human blastomeres over-express cell cycle drivers and under-express checkpoints.
records.model: Human 8-cell embryo, fibroblast and stem-cell microarrays
records.note: Eight-cell embryos overexpress cell-cycle drivers and structural segregation proteins while checkpoint expression is relatively low. The authors infer rapid cleavage may rely on cyclic protein expression and permit segregation errors.
records.uncertainty: Expression data do not directly test functional compensation.

records.title: The biochemistry of mitosis.
records.model: Mitosis across eukaryotic model systems
records.note: The article integrates antagonistic kinase/phosphatase modules, proteolysis and self-organization across distinct division contexts. It emphasizes organism-specific adaptation without a particular corrective intervention.
records.uncertainty: No abstract-level drug or rescue result is presented.

records.title: Small Noncoding RNA Signatures for Determining the Developmental Potential of an Embryo at the Morula Stage.
records.model: Spent morula culture media from 27 subfertile couples
records.note: Small-RNA profiles in culture medium associate with later embryo quality and development potential. Predicted targets implicate early development, but the authors call for experimental validation of RNA-target interactions.
records.uncertainty: Biomarker secretion/uptake associations are not a treatment test.

records.title: Modulation Of Microtubule Acetylation By The Interplay Of TPPP/p25, SIRT2 And New Anticancer Agents With Anti-SIRT2 Potency.
records.model: Tubulin/protein assembly experiments and HeLa-cell imaging
records.outcome_direction: microtubule hyperacetylation; elongation with degrader only
records.note: TPPP/p25 counteracts SIRT2 tubulin deacetylation. Both MZ242 and SH1 with TPPP/p25 cause microtubule hyperacetylation, but only SH1 couples this to process elongation, distinguishing a functional structural effect from acetylation alone.
records.uncertainty: Cell context and relevance to oligodendrocyte or muscle restoration need primary review.

records.title: NEIL3 may act as a potential prognostic biomarker for lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD public cohorts and clinical tissue validation
records.note: NEIL3 overexpression correlates with advanced disease, altered immune-cell proportions and poorer survival. A coexpression-based signature predicts outcomes; pathway activity is inferred from enrichment.
records.uncertainty: No causal intervention or restored function is tested.

records.title: SECAT: Quantifying Protein Complex Dynamics across Cell States by Network-Centric Analysis of SEC-SWATH-MS Profiles.
records.model: Multiple co-fractionation mass-spectrometry datasets
records.note: SECAT quantifies changing protein-complex networks across cell states using fractionation and mass spectrometry. The abstract establishes an analysis framework without a biological treatment or correction result.
records.uncertainty: Specific functional intervention outcomes are not supplied.

records.title: Recent advances in mechanisms ensuring the pairing, synapsis and segregation of XY chromosomes in mice and humans.
records.model: Mouse and human XY meiotic-recombination literature
records.note: The review explains mechanisms promoting crossover formation in the restricted XY pseudo-autosomal region and their relevance to sex-chromosome aneuploidy and fertility. No specific corrective intervention appears.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic and counseling implications are not efficacy evidence.

records.title: Construction of Gene Modules and Analysis of Prognostic Biomarkers for Cervical Cancer by Weighted Gene Co-Expression Network Analysis.
records.model: Cervical cancer expression cohorts and expression validation
records.note: Coexpression and interaction networks nominate cell-cycle-related hubs; TIPIN and POLA1 persist in a prognostic model and expression validation. No therapeutic perturbation is described.
records.uncertainty: Association and expression confirmation do not establish functional rescue.

records.title: Targeting protein function: the expanding toolkit for conditional disruption.
records.model: Conditional protein-perturbation methods in model organisms
records.note: The review surveys inducible protein cleavage, inactivation, sequestration and degradation to resolve rapid biological events. These are experimental tools rather than demonstrated treatments for a functional deficit.
records.uncertainty: No specific restorative result is supplied.

records.title: Unravelling turbot (<i>Scophthalmus maximus</i>) resistance to <i>Aeromonas salmonicida</i>: transcriptomic insights from two full-sibling families with divergent susceptibility.
records.model: Aeromonas-challenged turbot families with different susceptibility
records.note: Resistant fish show more controlled inflammation and immune-expression differences, alongside metabolic and cytoskeletal programs. Infection challenge characterizes inherited resistance rather than testing an administered therapy.
records.uncertainty: Transcriptomic associations do not identify a causal protective drug.

records.title: Allelic variation and differential expression of the mSIN3A histone deacetylase complex gene Arid4b promote mammary tumor growth and metastasis.
records.model: MMTV-PyMT and recombinant-inbred mouse models; breast cancer cells and patient expression
records.outcome_direction: ARID4B promotes metastasis; knockdown suppresses it
records.note: Arid4b overexpression promotes tumor growth and invasion, while knockdown reduces pulmonary metastases and a mitotic gene network. Allele-specific chromatin-complex binding supports its modifier role.
records.uncertainty: This is genetic tumor suppression, not restoration of normal tissue function.

records.title: Second German-Catalan workshop on epigenetics & cancer.
records.model: Epigenetics and cancer workshop report
records.note: The report summarizes talks and collaborations spanning methylation, chromatin, noncoding RNA and drug discovery. It names broad conceptual developments without individual administered-agent outcomes.
records.uncertainty: A meeting overview cannot establish candidate efficacy.

records.title: Different Mechanisms of Longevity in Long-Lived Mouse and Caenorhabditis elegans Mutants Revealed by Statistical Analysis of Mortality Rates.
records.model: Published survival of long-lived mouse and Caenorhabditis elegans mutants
records.note: Mortality-model analysis attributes mouse lifespan extension mainly to lower baseline vulnerability, whereas nematode mutants also reduce age-related mortality acceleration. It cautions against equating longer lifespan with uniformly slower aging.
records.uncertainty: Model interpretation and underlying datasets require verification; no drug was tested.

records.title: CCT5 maintains mitotic fidelity and promotes early colorectal tumorigenesis.
records.model: Early CRC tissues, engineered mice and CRC cells
records.note: CCT5 promotes MCC-CDC20-APC/C turnover and mitotic progression; depletion arrests CRC cells and limits early tumorigenesis. A fidelity-supporting chaperonin can therefore also support malignant growth.
records.uncertainty: No administered CCT5 intervention or normal-tissue rescue is reported.

records.title: Overexpression of ECT2 is a strong poor prognostic factor in ER(+) breast cancer.
records.model: Online breast cancer expression and outcome datasets
records.note: ECT2 overexpression associates with poorer outcome in ER-positive breast cancer, while higher basal-like and triple-negative expression is not prognostic. The study nominates a marker without functional intervention.
records.uncertainty: Subtype associations do not demonstrate causal treatment effects.

records.title: Regulation of the cell cycle and centrosome biology by deubiquitylases.
records.model: Mammalian cell-cycle, repair and centrosome deubiquitylase literature
records.note: The review catalogues deubiquitylases controlling cell-cycle progression, DNA repair and centrosome biology, including cancer-cell centrosome clustering. Druggability is discussed without a named efficacy result.
records.uncertainty: No specific restorative intervention can be inferred from the abstract.

records.title: Identification of COVID-19 and Dengue Host Factor Interaction Networks Based on Integrative Bioinformatics Analyses.
records.model: Bioinformatic host-factor networks for COVID-19 and dengue
records.note: Shared host factors and pathway analyses nominate resveratrol, genistein and dexamethasone for coinfection. The authors acknowledge that findings require validation; no compound administration is described.
records.uncertainty: Candidate matching is not observed antiviral or restorative efficacy.

records.title: Tpr directly binds to Mad1 and Mad2 and is important for the Mad1-Mad2-mediated mitotic spindle checkpoint.
records.model: HeLa cells depleted of nuclear-pore protein Tpr
records.note: Tpr binds Mad1/Mad2; depletion disrupts interphase localization, reduces Mad1-bound Mad2 and diminishes kinetochore Mad1. These defects explain impaired Mad2 activation and checkpoint signaling.
records.uncertainty: No treatment or compensatory rescue is described.

records.title: Postnatal telomere dysfunction induces cardiomyocyte cell-cycle arrest through p21 activation.
records.model: Postnatal wild-type, Terc-deficient and Terc/p21-double-deficient mouse hearts
records.outcome_direction: genetic rescue of post-injury cardiomyocyte proliferation
records.note: Premature telomere dysfunction causes cardiomyocyte arrest and abolishes the newborn proliferative response to injury; removing p21 restores that response in Terc-deficient mice. This is direct genetic compensation in a cardiac model.
records.uncertainty: Rescued proliferation is not proven durable heart function or pharmacological benefit.

records.title: Defining the fetal origin of MLL-AF4 infant leukemia highlights specific fatty acid requirements.
records.model: Human and mouse fetal-to-adult hematopoietic profiling; MLL-AF4 leukemia validation
records.note: A fetal transcriptional program persists in infant leukemia; functional validation identifies essential genes, including PLK1 and fatty-acid-associated ELOVL1. An available PLK1 inhibitor is mentioned as an opportunity.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not name or establish administration of that inhibitor.

records.title: Single-Base Pair Genome Editing in Human Cells by Using Site-Specific Endonucleases.
records.model: Single-base genome-editing methods in human cells
records.note: The review describes programmable-nuclease single-base editing for testing disease-variant causality and possible clinical use. No specific disorder rescue or administered drug result is given.
records.uncertainty: Potential clinical use is prospective.

records.title: Non-oncogenic roles of TAp73: from multiciliogenesis to metabolism.
records.model: TAp73 multiciliogenesis and metabolic-regulation studies
records.note: The review cites functional rescue supporting TAp73 as an upstream ciliogenesis regulator and describes metabolic-enzyme control. Loss causes severe ciliary clearance and developmental defects, making restoration experiments worth tracing.
records.uncertainty: Rescue method, measured function and disease context are not specified here.

records.title: Targeting subcellular localization through the polo-box domain: non-ATP competitive inhibitors recapitulate a PLK1 phenotype.
records.model: Cell-based PLK1 localization and spindle assays
records.note: Peptide-fragment inhibitors reduce centrosomal PLK1 and cause mono- and multipolar spindles while suppressing proliferation. Selectivity over PLK3 supports antitumor development, not chromosome-fidelity improvement.
records.uncertainty: Individual peptide names and normal-cell effects are unspecified.

records.title: Emerging Roles of PTTG1/Securin in Breast Cancer.
records.model: Securin/PTTG1 breast cancer literature
records.note: The review links securin dysregulation to segregation defects, malignant behavior and poor breast cancer outcomes. It discusses prospective targeting without a specific treatment or restorative experiment.
records.uncertainty: No administered-agent efficacy is provided.

records.title: Overexpression of HPRT1 is associated with poor prognosis in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
records.model: HNSCC expression, mutation, clinical and drug-sensitivity analyses
records.outcome_direction: adverse prognosis and predicted drug sensitivity
records.note: HPRT1 overexpression associates with disease features and cell-cycle networks; higher expression predicts resistance to abiraterone and sensitivity to tozasertib/teniposide. No administration experiment is described.
records.uncertainty: Drug-response associations do not establish therapeutic benefit.

records.title: (Z)-1-aryl-3-arylamino-2-propen-1-ones, highly active stimulators of tubulin polymerization: synthesis, structure-activity relationship (SAR), tubulin polymerization, and cell growth inhibition studies.
records.model: Twenty tumor cell lines including multidrug-resistant phenotypes
records.note: 10ae stabilizes microtubules, induces G2/M arrest and activates caspase-associated apoptosis across tumor lines. Paclitaxel is a mechanistic comparison in the abstract, not established as a tested arm.
records.uncertainty: Microtubule stabilization here is cytotoxic rather than shown to restore function.

records.title: Surfaceome analyses uncover CD98hc as an antibody drug-conjugate target in triple negative breast cancer.
records.model: Triple-negative breast cancer cells and xenografts
records.note: A CD98hc antibody internalizes into lysosomes; its emtansine conjugate blocks the cell cycle and causes mitotic-catastrophe death in vitro and antitumor effects in vivo.
records.uncertainty: No normal-tissue restoration or chromosome-fidelity benefit is described.

records.title: Syndromic Wilms tumor: a review of predisposing conditions, surveillance and treatment.
records.model: Syndromic Wilms-tumor management literature
records.note: The review addresses inherited syndromes, screening and nephron-sparing surgery, with attention to renal risk and treatment susceptibility. It reports no named pharmacological rescue.
records.uncertainty: Surgical preservation and syndrome-specific care cannot be read as molecular correction.

records.title: Whole-genome doubling confers unique genetic vulnerabilities on tumour cells.
records.model: Human tumor datasets and cancer-cell dependency studies
records.note: Whole-genome-doubled cancer cells depend more on checkpoint, replication and proteasome pathways; KIF18A loss produces mitotic errors and reduces their viability. This is selective vulnerability, not restored normal segregation.
records.uncertainty: Therapeutic strategies are proposed; no administered agent is named.

records.title: Differential expression of AURKA/PLK4 in quiescence and senescence of osteosarcoma U2OS cells.
records.model: Quiescent, senescent and control U2OS expression dataset
records.note: Reanalysis identifies shared gene-expression changes between quiescence and senescence, highlighting AURKA and PLK4. No intervention tests whether either reverses senescence or restores function.
records.uncertainty: Network centrality alone does not establish causality.

records.title: Predicting cooperative drug effects through the quantitative cellular profiling of response to individual drugs.
records.model: Drug-response expression data compared with experimental combination results
records.note: A correlation-based expression framework predicts some drug combinations when their individual transcriptomic mechanisms are related, but fails for others. This concerns prediction limits rather than a named effective treatment.
records.uncertainty: No specific agents or functional rescue outcomes are given.

records.title: Identification of Key Genes and Pathways in Cervical Cancer by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Cervical cancer expression datasets and network analyses
records.note: Differential expression emphasizes increased mitotic programs and reduced differentiation programs, with multiple cell-cycle hubs. The study proposes targets using bioinformatics without therapeutic testing.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic driver claims are stronger than the described associative design.

records.title: Structure of the human outer kinetochore KMN network complex
records.model: Human KMN-network cryo-EM structure
records.outcome_direction: structural basis of kinetochore assembly control
records.note: The structure reveals robust intersubunit connections and MIS12C autoinhibition involving Dsn1 Ser100/Ser109. Relieving this inhibition by phosphorylation offers a specific mechanism for restricting outer-kinetochore assembly to functional centromeres.
records.uncertainty: Structural inference is not a demonstrated pharmacological or disease-model rescue.

records.title: Deciphering lactate/lactylation networks in AML: integrated scRNA-seq and transcriptomics reveal functions and prognostic model.
records.model: AML single-cell and bulk transcriptomes with expression validation
records.outcome_direction: prognostic and in silico drug-response associations
records.note: A lactate/lactylation-associated signature separates AML outcomes and predicts treatment responses, including sensitivity to ABT-737/AZD4547. RNA and protein validation confirm expression differences, not drug efficacy.
records.uncertainty: Predicted sensitivity is explicitly computational; no administration is described.

records.title: Identification of significant genes signatures and prognostic biomarkers in cervical squamous carcinoma via bioinformatic data.
records.model: Cervical squamous carcinoma datasets and tissue validation
records.note: RFC4, MCM2 and TOP2A correlate with survival and are elevated in tumors; RFC4 receives RNA/protein validation. This establishes candidate markers without treatment or functional rescue testing.
records.uncertainty: Expression validation does not establish therapeutic causality.

records.title: Cabozantinib and dasatinib synergize to induce tumor regression in non-clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
records.model: Human kidney-cancer cells and in vivo non-clear-cell RCC model
records.note: Cabozantinib plus dasatinib reduces cell viability and regresses tumors with reported tolerability; combined profiling implicates MAPK-ERK downregulation, and MEK inhibition also improves anticancer activity.
records.uncertainty: This is tumor-directed efficacy without restorative normal-cell endpoints.

records.title: A massively parallel pipeline to clone DNA variants and examine molecular phenotypes of human disease mutations.
records.model: Human disease-variant cloning and protein-interaction assays
records.note: Clone-seq generates mutant alleles and assesses protein stability and interactions; interface mutations more often disrupt binding, and similar molecular effects track shared disease. The work develops characterization tools.
records.uncertainty: No variant correction or functional rescue intervention is presented.

records.title: Multi-Omics Analysis Reveals Immune Infiltration and Clinical Significance of Phosphorylation Modification Enzymes in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD multi-omics and inferred treatment-response analyses
records.note: A phosphorylation-enzyme network and PSig score stratify survival, mutation burden and immune features. Drug and immunotherapy sensitivity are analytical associations rather than administered-treatment restoration evidence.
records.uncertainty: Clinical utility and causal effects remain untested in the abstract.

records.title: Uncovering the role of the subcommissural organ in early brain development through transcriptomic analysis.
records.model: Embryonic chick subcommissural organ at two developmental stages
records.note: Transcriptomes indicate early proliferative and later secretory programs, with growth-factor and guidance-gene expression suggesting a source of embryonic cerebrospinal-fluid signals. No administered growth factor or functional restoration is tested.
records.uncertainty: Secretory capability is inferred from expression.

records.title: An Nlrp5-null mutation leads to attenuated de novo methylation in oocytes, accompanied by a significant reduction in DNMT3L.
records.model: Nlrp5-null mouse germinal-vesicle oocytes
records.note: Nlrp5 loss broadly alters maternal proteins, markedly lowers DNMT3L and attenuates DNA methylation including some imprinting regions. The findings connect maternal-complex integrity to epigenetic establishment.
records.uncertainty: No DNMT3L replacement or other rescue is described.

records.title: Changing roles of aurora-B kinase in two life cycle stages of Trypanosoma brucei.
records.model: Procyclic and bloodstream Trypanosoma brucei
records.note: TbAUK1 knockdown or inactive-mutant expression disrupts mitosis and cytokinesis, with bloodstream cells continuing DNA and organelle replication. The study demonstrates developmental differences in Aurora-related cell-cycle control.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic restoration or administered inhibitor is reported.

records.title: Development of type 1 diabetes mellitus in nonobese diabetic mice follows changes in thymocyte and peripheral T lymphocyte transcriptional activity.
records.model: Prediabetic and diabetic NOD-mouse thymocytes and peripheral T cells
records.note: T-cell maturation and diabetes onset associate with sequential differentiation, tolerance, apoptosis and inflammatory/cytotoxic expression programs. The study profiles disease development without treating it.
records.uncertainty: Temporal association does not establish a corrective intervention.

records.title: Transcriptomic landscape based on annotated clinical features reveals PLPP2 involvement in lipid raft-mediated proliferation signature of early-stage lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Early LUAD cohorts, cultured cells and tumor-bearing mice
records.note: PLPP2 promotes lipid-raft formation and excessive LUAD proliferation; knockdown and MβCD experiments probe this route. The abstract combines genetic and chemical evidence without isolating a quantitative MβCD result.
records.uncertainty: MβCD-specific outcome and normal-cell effects require primary detail.

records.title: Vitamins, Coenzyme Q10, and Antioxidant Strategies to Improve Oocyte Quality in Women with Gynecological Cancers: A Comprehensive Review.
records.model: Fertility-preservation literature for women with gynecological cancers
records.note: The review attributes mitochondrial and DNA-damage improvements to CoQ10 and antioxidant or ovarian-quality effects to vitamins A, C, D3 and E. These are potential functional-protection routes requiring primary-source tracing.
records.uncertainty: Narrative evidence, cancer-treatment applicability and dosing are unresolved.

records.title: Histone deacetylase inhibitors: a chemical genetics approach to understanding cellular functions.
records.model: HDAC inhibitor cellular-function literature
records.outcome_direction: anticancer effects and broader therapeutic potential reviewed
records.note: HDAC inhibitors modify histone and nonhistone functions and can induce transformed-cell death. Nononcologic potential is asserted broadly without a named treatment or functional rescue example.
records.uncertainty: No specific restorative outcome is available from this abstract.

records.title: Maternal SNPs in the p53 pathway: risk factors for trisomy 21?
records.model: Mothers of Down-syndrome children and control mothers
records.note: Individual p53-pathway polymorphisms do not distinguish groups, while selected TP53/MDM2 and TP53/USP7 allele combinations associate with Down-syndrome birth risk. No intervention is evaluated.
records.uncertainty: Association of combined alleles does not demonstrate causal aneuploidy correction.

records.title: Comparative Transcriptome Analysis Reveals the Innate Immune Response to Mycoplasma gallisepticum Infection in Chicken Embryos and Newly Hatched Chicks.
records.model: Mycoplasma-infected chicken embryos and newly hatched chicks
records.note: Infection produces weight loss and immune injury; embryos show a stronger transcriptomic inflammatory response than chicks. Toll-like-receptor pathways, including TLR7, are nominated for mechanistic followup.
records.uncertainty: No treatment or immune-function rescue is tested.

records.title: Cdc20 is critical for meiosis I and fertility of female mice.
records.model: Cdc20-hypomorphic mice and female oocytes/embryos
records.outcome_direction: meiotic missegregation despite normal somatic lifespan
records.note: Low Cdc20 permits apparently healthy mice but causes severe female reproductive failure, chromosome misalignment/lagging and inefficient anaphase-substrate degradation. This reveals tissue-specific risk from reducing APC/C activation.
records.uncertainty: Genetic hypomorphism is not an inhibitor trial; relevance depends on intervention exposure.

records.title: Polo-like kinase-1 controls Aurora A destruction by activating APC/C-Cdh1.
records.model: Mitotic Plk1-depletion and Cdh1/Cdc14A experiments
records.note: Plk1 loss impairs Cdh1 dephosphorylation and timely Aurora A degradation; phosphorylation of Cdc14A is implicated in APC/C-Cdh1 activation during mitotic exit.
records.uncertainty: No rescue or pharmacological enhancement is described.

records.title: DIAPH3 is upregulated in high-grade gliomas and linked to chromosomal instability.
records.model: Glioma datasets and glioblastoma cell lines
records.note: DIAPH3 rises in mitotic and high-grade glioma cells; its knockdown increases aneuploidy, supporting a role in segregation fidelity. Expression adds little prognostic value beyond current classification.
records.uncertainty: Loss-of-function harm does not demonstrate augmentation benefit.

records.title: APC/C-mediated degradation of dsRNA-binding protein 4 (DRB4) involved in RNA silencing.
records.model: Arabidopsis APC/C perturbation and DRB4 interaction assays
records.outcome_direction: protein accumulation without detected small-RNA defect
records.note: APC/C depletion strongly increases DRB4, a non-cell-cycle substrate, but DRB4 overexpression produces no detected small-RNA-production defect. The authors favor protein-homeostasis maintenance over established regulatory consequences.
records.uncertainty: Proteasome inactivation method is unnamed; conditional effects remain possible.

records.title: Constitutively elevated levels of SOCS1 suppress innate responses in DF-1 immortalised chicken fibroblast cells.

administered_agents.name: PBG98 attenuated infectious bursal disease virus

records.model: Immortalized DF-1 and primary chicken embryo fibroblasts
records.note: DF-1 cells have elevated SOCS1 and blunted innate signaling; SOCS1 knockdown enhances interferon-stimulated genes and reduces viral yield under interferon stimulation. Overexpression worsens both directions, supporting genetic functional compensation.
records.uncertainty: Rescue depends on this avian-cell and stimulation context; no SOCS1 drug is tested.

records.title: Molecular Pathogenesis of Gene Regulation by the miR-150 Duplex: miR-150-3p Regulates TNS4 in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD cell lines and clinical specimens
records.note: Ectopic miR-150 strands suppress LUAD malignancy, with miR-150-3p directly regulating TNS4. Downstream genomic-stability-associated genes are identified but fidelity restoration is not demonstrated.
records.uncertainty: Genetic antitumor effects are not normal-cell functional rescue.

records.title: Oncogenic MYC amplifies mitotic perturbations.
records.model: MYC-overexpressing cells with anti-mitotic challenges
records.note: MYC overexpression alters spindle behavior and timing, and anti-mitotic challenges produce greater abnormalities and micronuclei. PLK1-centered changes provide context-dependent counterevidence to assuming mitotic perturbation improves fidelity.
records.uncertainty: Specific drugs and doses are absent; mechanism also includes genetic MYC manipulation.

records.title: The Role of Biomarkers in Adrenocortical Carcinoma: A Review of Current Evidence and Future Perspectives.
records.model: Adrenocortical carcinoma diagnostic and prognostic literature
records.note: The review describes diagnostic difficulty, limited therapy and candidate metabolomic/genetic biomarkers in adrenocortical carcinoma. It does not identify an administered restorative intervention.
records.uncertainty: Broad future directions are not efficacy findings.

records.title: CDK1 phosphorylation of TAZ in mitosis inhibits its oncogenic activity.
records.model: TAZ phosphorylation-mutant assays in immortalized epithelial cells
records.outcome_direction: nonphosphorylatable TAZ increases malignancy and segregation defects
records.note: CDK1 phosphorylates TAZ during mitosis; a multi-site nonphosphorylatable mutant has stronger oncogenic activity and greater spindle/centrosome and segregation abnormalities than S89A alone.
records.uncertainty: Comparative mutant effects do not establish pharmacological rescue.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint activation and silencing at kinetochores.
records.model: Kinetochore spindle-checkpoint literature
records.note: The review summarizes how unattached kinetochores generate APC/C inhibition and how attachments silence checkpoint signaling, emphasizing unresolved mechanisms. No specific restoration result is described.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or efficacy endpoint appears.

records.title: The chromatin remodeller RSF1 is essential for PLK1 deposition and function at mitotic kinetochores.
records.model: RSF1-depleted mitotic cells and engineered RSF1 constructs
records.outcome_direction: restored PLK1 localization and chromosome alignment
records.note: RSF1 C-terminal expression restores kinetochore PLK1, while phosphomimetic S1375D or S1359D rescues depletion-induced chromosome misalignment. S1375A fails, supporting a specific phosphorylation-dependent genetic fidelity-rescue route.
records.uncertainty: Drug access to this mechanism and rescue outside RSF1 depletion are unknown.

records.title: The small-molecule VEGF receptor inhibitor pazopanib (GW786034B) targets both tumor and endothelial cells in multiple myeloma.
records.model: Myeloma/endothelial cultures and mouse human-myeloma xenografts
records.note: Pazopanib suppresses VEGF signaling, tumor/endothelial interactions, angiogenesis and myeloma growth, prolonging xenograft survival. Low-dose combinations show enhanced cytotoxicity.
records.uncertainty: Benefits are antitumor; proposed reduced toxicity and resistance reversal are not separately established.

records.title: Stem cell-like ALDH(bright) cellular states in EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer: a novel mechanism of acquired resistance to erlotinib targetable with the natural polyphenol silibinin.

administered_agents.name: erlotinib
administered_agents.role: continuous exposure used to establish resistance

records.model: EGFR-mutant NSCLC resistance model
records.note: Erlotinib-resistant cultures become enriched for ALDH-bright cells; silibinin reduces this population and sphere formation. The abstract cites in vivo resistance circumvention but chiefly details cell-state and self-renewal suppression.
records.uncertainty: This is anticancer resistance targeting, not normal-cell restoration.

records.title: Integration of metabolomics and transcriptomics provides insights into enhanced osteogenesis in Ano5Cys360Tyr knock-in mouse model.
records.model: Ano5 Cys360Tyr knock-in mouse calvarial osteoblasts
records.note: Mutant osteoblasts proliferate more and deposit calcium-rich nodules with altered metabolism and calcium-related expression. Enhanced osteogenesis represents the GDD disease phenotype rather than a therapeutic benefit.
records.uncertainty: No corrective treatment is evaluated.

records.title: mDia formins form hetero-oligomers and cooperatively maintain murine hematopoiesis.
records.model: mDia1/mDia2-deficient murine hematopoietic cells under stress
records.note: mDia1 and mDia2 form hetero-oligomers and jointly support actin organization, transcription and stem/progenitor regeneration. Double deficiency causes severe anemia, progenitor loss and early mortality.
records.uncertainty: Necessity for regeneration does not show a restoration intervention.

records.title: Vasohibin-1 is identified as a master-regulator of endothelial cell apoptosis using gene network analysis.
records.model: Serum-withdrawn endothelial cells and VASH1 siRNA
records.note: Network predictions are partly validated by targeted VASH1 knockdown, which protects endothelial cells from serum-withdrawal death. This is direct genetic cytoprotection in a defined stress model.
records.uncertainty: No administered VASH1 inhibitor or retained endothelial functional endpoint is described.

records.title: Mycoplasma hyopneumoniae J elicits an antioxidant response and decreases the expression of ciliary genes in infected swine epithelial cells.
records.model: Mycoplasma hyopneumoniae-infected swine NPTr epithelial cells
records.note: Infection changes miRNA/mRNA profiles, raises antioxidant programs and lowers ciliary/cytoskeletal expression. NRF2 involvement and altered extracellular-vesicle miRNAs are proposed mechanisms.
records.uncertainty: An endogenous antioxidant response is not demonstrated therapeutic protection.

records.title: Lactate-induced protein lactylation in cancer: functions, biomarkers and immunotherapy strategies.
records.model: Lactate/lactylation cancer literature
records.note: The review discusses lactate-responsive proteins, lactylation-mediated gene regulation and links to adverse cancer outcomes. It proposes future targeting without a specific administered treatment or rescue.
records.uncertainty: Therapeutic modulation remains unspecified.

records.title: ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complexes as novel targets for cancer therapy.
records.model: ATP-dependent chromatin-remodeling cancer literature
records.note: The review argues that chromatin remodeling enables malignant gene expression and discusses strategies to discover small-molecule regulators. It does not report a named corrective intervention.
records.uncertainty: Target rationale should not be treated as observed efficacy.

records.title: Effects of aspirin on colon cancer using quantitative proteomic analysis.
records.model: HT29 and colorectal cancer-cell proteomics/viability assays
records.note: Aspirin exposure, including 10 mmol/L proteomics conditions, raises p53, lowers CDK1 and induces arrest/apoptosis. These high-concentration cellular effects support a cancer-mechanism hypothesis rather than restored normal function.
records.uncertainty: Clinical prevention and achievable exposure are not established by these assays.

records.title: Expression profiling of genes regulated by sphingosine kinase1 signaling in a murine model of hyperoxia induced neonatal bronchopulmonary dysplasia.
records.model: Hyperoxia-exposed neonatal Sphk1-knockout and wild-type mouse lungs
records.note: The current expression study supports previously reported Sphk1-knockout protection against hyperoxic lung injury; knockout avoids wild-type suppression of spindle-related genes and reduces injury-associated programs. This suggests a nononcologic protective target.
records.uncertainty: The protection result is cited from prior work; no SphK1 drug is administered here.

records.title: Ubiquitin ligase Ufd2 is required for efficient degradation of Mps1 kinase.
records.model: Yeast UFD2 deletion and human Mps1-degradation experiments
records.note: Ufd2 is required for efficient Mps1 ubiquitination/degradation, with spindle and chromosome-stability phenotypes in deficient yeast and conserved turnover in humans.
records.uncertainty: No compensation or therapeutic restoration is described.

records.title: Exploration of histone protein γ-H2AX as a prognostic factor in soft tissue sarcomas and its association with biological behavior, immune cell environment and survival in leiomyosarcoma.
records.model: Soft-tissue sarcoma transcriptomes and tissue microarrays
records.note: High H2AX/γ-H2AX associates with poorer leiomyosarcoma survival, cell-cycle programs and differing immune infiltration. Separate tissue data support marker associations without intervention.
records.uncertainty: Prognostic association is not evidence that modifying H2AX improves function.

records.title: Identification of potential therapeutic target SPP1 and related RNA regulatory pathway in keloid based on bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Keloid expression datasets and RNA/miRNA profiling
records.note: SPP1 elevation and a predicted NEAT1/miR-181a-5p/SPP1 axis are identified through datasets and expression validation. The therapeutic-target conclusion remains speculative.
records.uncertainty: No pathway perturbation or scar-function improvement is tested.

records.title: Increased CDK1 activity determines the timing of kinetochore-microtubule attachments in meiosis I.
records.model: Mouse meiosis-I oocytes with altered CDK1 activity
records.outcome_direction: timing-dependent attachment control and error induction
records.note: Reducing CDK1 delays stable kinetochore attachments, whereas premature elevation stabilizes attachments too early and produces anaphase lagging. Proper activity timing, rather than simply greater kinase activity, supports meiotic fidelity.
records.uncertainty: Perturbation agents/methods are unspecified; no disease rescue is shown.

records.title: Longer metaphase and fewer chromosome segregation errors in modern human than Neanderthal brain development.
records.model: Humanized mice, human brain organoids and chimpanzee organoids
records.outcome_direction: improved segregation fidelity with defined substitutions
records.note: Modern-human KIF18A/KNL1 substitutions lengthen metaphase and reduce segregation errors in developing cortical progenitors; ancestral substitutions reverse these effects in human organoids. This directly links modest genetic changes to better fidelity.
records.uncertainty: Not a drug experiment; transfer to other genetic deficits or tissues is unknown.

records.title: Whole Blood Transcriptome Analysis of Mycoplasma mycoides Subsp. mycoides-Infected Cattle Confirms Immunosuppression but Does Not Reflect Local Inflammation.
records.model: Six cattle before and after contact challenge with Mycoplasma mycoides
records.note: Blood transcriptomes during acute infection show predominantly reduced expression without recapitulating characteristic local lung inflammation. The study highlights tissue-sampling limits for immune-response interpretation.
records.uncertainty: Vaccines are background; no vaccine or therapy efficacy is tested here.

records.title: Gene network-based analysis identifies two potential subtypes of small intestinal neuroendocrine tumors.
records.model: Small-intestinal neuroendocrine tumor datasets and independent expression validation
records.note: Network reanalysis identifies secretory, developmental and hypoxic programs and suggests two neuroendocrine subtypes. Independent qPCR confirms most selected expression changes without functional intervention.
records.uncertainty: Proposed diagnostic and treatment implications remain inferential.

records.title: Illicit survival of cancer cells during polyploidization and depolyploidization.
records.model: Tetraploid and aneuploid cancer-cell literature
records.note: The review describes how tetraploid cells evade checkpoints and generate unstable descendants through abnormal divisions. Selective survival-pathway targeting is proposed as an anticancer strategy.
records.uncertainty: No specific administered agent or normal-function correction is reported.

records.title: Endometrial profile of tamoxifen and low-dose estradiol combination therapy.

administered_agents.name: tamoxifen
administered_agents.role: SERM alone or combined with estradiol

records.model: Randomized postmenopausal cynomolgus macaques over four months
records.outcome_direction: mixed antagonism and adverse endometrial changes
records.note: Tamoxifen blocks estradiol-induced proliferation but both tamoxifen regimens cause fibrosis/cystic changes and retain uterine effects. Reduced proliferation does not imply complete protection from endometrial risk.
records.uncertainty: Small preclinical hormone study; long-term clinical risks are not determined.

records.title: Kinase and Phosphatase Cross-Talk at the Kinetochore.
records.model: Kinetochore kinase/phosphatase signaling literature
records.note: The review integrates direct KMN-network regulation and secondary effects across Aurora B, Mps1, Bub1, Plk1, Cdk1, PP1 and PP2A-B56. Single-enzyme inhibition can indirectly change the whole signaling network.
records.uncertainty: No specific restorative intervention is established; useful mechanistic context only.

records.title: Genetic Susceptibility to Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Patients with Chronic Hepatitis Virus Infection.
records.model: HCC germline susceptibility GWAS literature
records.note: The review organizes HCC-associated loci by chronic hepatitis infection context and proposes risk-stratified screening. It does not present pharmacological or genetic correction outcomes.
records.uncertainty: Risk prediction and future treatment potential are not intervention evidence.

records.title: Mad2 and the APC/C compete for the same site on Cdc20 to ensure proper chromosome segregation.
records.model: Cdc20 binding assays and Mad2-binding-defective mutant in cells
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint disruption when Mad2 competition is lost
records.note: Mad2 competes with APC/C for a shared Cdc20-binding region; a mutant with weak Mad2 binding abolishes checkpoint function. This adds direct competitive inhibition to the known pseudosubstrate mechanism.
records.uncertainty: No engineered or drug rescue is described.

records.title: The lncRNA GATA3-AS1/miR-495-3p/CENPU axis predicts poor prognosis of breast cancer via the PLK1 signaling pathway.
records.model: Breast cancer expression/outcome data and unspecified functional analyses
records.note: CENPU and PLK1-pathway coexpression correlate with poor breast cancer outcome; predicted miRNA/lncRNA relationships nominate a GATA3-AS1 axis. The abstract supplies no specific rescue experiment.
records.uncertainty: Functional-analysis methods and causal effects are insufficiently detailed.

records.title: Cell cycle regulation: p53-p21-RB signaling.
records.model: p53-p21-RB and DREAM cell-cycle signaling literature
records.note: The review explains indirect p53 repression through p21, RB-E2F and DREAM, including overlapping and distinct target sets. It provides regulatory context without a specific corrective intervention.
records.uncertainty: No administered drug or tissue-function rescue is reported.

records.title: GD-Net: An Integrated Multimodal Information Model Based on Deep Learning for Cancer Outcome Prediction and Informative Feature Selection.
records.model: Eight cancer multi-omics datasets with validation
records.note: GD-Net combines multimodal information for survival prediction and feature selection, reporting better discrimination than benchmarks. Identified biomarkers do not constitute tested therapeutic targets.
records.uncertainty: Computational performance does not establish clinical treatment benefit.

records.title: QIGTD: identifying critical genes in the evolution of lung adenocarcinoma with tensor decomposition.
records.model: LUAD temporal gene-network datasets
records.note: Tensor-decomposition analysis ranks genes from stage-related networks and enriches known LUAD associations and mitotic processes. This is a computational discovery method without therapeutic perturbation.
records.uncertainty: Database overlap and enrichment are not causal validation.

records.title: Small changes in phospho-occupancy at the kinetochore-microtubule interface drive mitotic fidelity.
records.model: Quantitative Hec1 phospho-occupancy and attachment-error experiments
records.note: Hec1 phosphorylation occupies a narrow fractional range, with small changes supporting attachment-error correction through Cdk1/cyclin B1 and Aurora activity. Ongoing phosphatase action balances attachment stability against correction.
records.uncertainty: No named administered intervention or disease rescue; indiscriminate modulation may not reproduce the balance.

records.title: Extracellular vesicles secreted by cumulus cells contain microRNAs that are potential regulatory factors of mouse oocyte developmental competence.
records.model: Mouse cumulus-cell feeder cultures, oocytes and extracellular-vesicle profiling
records.outcome_direction: candidate extracellular support of developmental competence
records.note: Building on prior feeder-dependent blastocyst development, this study shows cumulus EVs enter oocytes and carry differing miRNAs linked computationally to developmental processes. It suggests a transferable support route beyond small molecules.
records.uncertainty: Direct EV/miRNA causality or isolated-EV rescue is not demonstrated here.

records.title: Integrin-mediated adhesion orients the spindle parallel to the substratum in an EB1- and myosin X-dependent manner.
records.model: Nonpolarized cultured cells on defined substrates
records.note: Fibronectin or collagen supports planar spindle orientation, whereas nonintegrin adhesion or integrin blockade disrupts it. Actin, astral microtubules, myosin X and EB1 mediate this physical-context effect.
records.uncertainty: No disease-model rescue; substrate effects should not be conflated with drug efficacy.

records.title: A TPR domain-containing N-terminal module of MPS1 is required for its kinetochore localization by Aurora B.
records.model: MPS1-domain mutants, structural analysis and kinetochore assays
records.note: The MPS1 N-terminal extension provides binding activity, while deleting its TPR domain makes kinetochore localization insensitive to Aurora B inhibition. This reveals a removable localization constraint.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not specify whether Aurora B inhibition was pharmacological or genetic. Bypassed localization does not establish restored checkpoint fidelity under inhibition.

records.title: A subgroup of microRNAs defines PTEN-deficient, triple-negative breast cancer patients with poorest prognosis and alterations in RB1, MYC, and Wnt signaling.
records.model: Human triple-negative breast cancer multi-omics cohorts
records.note: Low PTEN combined with low expression of several miRNAs defines an adverse-outcome TNBC subgroup with RB1/MYC/β-catenin features. Connectivity mapping predicts PI3K-inhibitor response without administration.
records.uncertainty: Predicted treatment sensitivity is not observed benefit.

records.title: PPARG is a potential target of Tanshinone IIA in prostate cancer treatment: a combination study of molecular docking and dynamic simulation based on transcriptomic bioinformatics.
records.model: Prostate-cancer transcriptomics, docking and molecular dynamics
records.note: The study nominates PPARG as a tanshinone IIA target using transcriptomic analysis, docking and dynamics. It explicitly calls for biological verification of the proposed mechanism.
records.uncertainty: Abstract does not specify the exposure experiment or establish target engagement and efficacy.

records.title: Bub1 kinase targets Sgo1 to ensure efficient chromosome biorientation in budding yeast mitosis.
records.model: Bub1 kinase-domain-deficient budding yeast
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint arrest retained but recovery fidelity impaired
records.note: Bub1 kinase-domain deletion preserves arrest under spindle disruption yet causes post-nocodazole missegregation with Sgo1 mislocalization. This separates an intact arrest response from successful chromosome biorientation.
records.uncertainty: Genetic challenge study; no compensating drug is tested.

records.title: Human Bub1 protects centromeric sister-chromatid cohesion through Shugoshin during mitosis.
records.model: Bub1- or Sgo1-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: Bub1 depletion lowers/mislocalizes Sgo1, causing centromeric cohesion loss and massive missegregation despite Mad2/Aurora-dependent arrest. Cohesion loss does not require full separase activation.
records.uncertainty: BUB1 is distinct from BUB1B; no therapeutic rescue is described.

records.title: Population genetic characteristics of Hainan medaka with whole-genome resequencing.
records.model: Whole-genome resequencing of four medaka populations
records.note: The Sanya population shows strong differentiation, a recent bottleneck and environmental-selection signals around candidate regions. The study explores adaptation after loss of the male DMY gene without intervention.
records.uncertainty: Candidate regions do not demonstrate functional genetic compensation.

records.title: BUB1 mediation of caspase-independent mitotic death determines cell fate.
records.model: BUB1-deficient cells and chromosomal- versus microsatellite-unstable colon cancer lines
records.note: Checkpoint-provoking drugs induce p73/AIF/endonuclease-G-dependent mitotic death at low BUB1, whereas complete BUB1 depletion yields aneuploidy. This exposes a dose/context-dependent survival-fidelity tradeoff rather than restoration.
records.uncertainty: BUB1 is not BUB1B; exact depletion and exposure conditions need primary review.

records.title: Securin and separase phosphorylation act redundantly to maintain sister chromatid cohesion in mammalian cells.
records.model: Securin-null mouse embryonic stem cells with nonphosphorylatable separase
records.note: Securin loss is buffered by separase inhibitory phosphorylation; combining securin deletion with S1121A separase abolishes cohesion maintenance under spindle disruption and prevents recovery. This identifies an endogenous compensatory safeguard.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacological enhancement of the safeguard is shown.

records.title: Deciphering <i>KDM8</i> dysregulation and CpG methylation in hepatocellular carcinoma using multi-omics and machine learning.
records.model: TCGA liver-cancer multi-omics and predictive modeling
records.note: KDM8 downregulation associates with CpG hypermethylation and a proliferative, less liver-specific network. A predictive signature emphasizes cg02871891 without testing demethylation or rescue.
records.uncertainty: Causality and therapeutic correction are unestablished.

records.title: PKCβ1 regulates meiotic cell cycle in mouse oocyte.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with PKCβI depletion or overexpression
records.outcome_direction: depletion and excess perturb different meiotic steps
records.note: PKCβI depletion disrupts spindles, alignment and polar-body extrusion; overexpression delays G2/M entry through cyclin-B1/Cdc2 regulation. Directional effects depend on the meiotic step.
records.uncertainty: No rescue or administered kinase modulator is described.

records.title: PRMT5 Inhibition Modulates E2F1 Methylation and Gene-Regulatory Networks Leading to Therapeutic Efficacy in JAK2<sup>V617F</sup>-Mutant MPN.
records.model: Primary MPN cells; JAK2 V617F polycythemia and MPL W515L myelofibrosis models
records.outcome_direction: improved disease counts, organ enlargement and fibrosis
records.note: PRMT5 inhibition reverses elevated blood counts and organ enlargement and reduces fibrosis; JAK cotargeting improves disease control further. Mechanistically it impairs repair, arrests cells and induces apoptosis rather than improving genomic fidelity.
records.uncertainty: Agents are unnamed; organ effects remain within malignant hematopoiesis models.

records.title: Shugoshin-2 is essential for the completion of meiosis but not for mitotic cell division in mice.
records.model: Sgol2-knockout mice, somatic cells and germ cells
records.note: SGOL2 loss leaves examined somatic division and adult development apparently intact but causes premature meiotic REC8 release, loss of centromeric cohesion and infertility in both sexes.
records.uncertainty: No intervention restores cohesion; absence of somatic phenotype is context-limited.

records.title: RSK1-driven TRIM28/E2F1 feedback loop promotes castration-resistant prostate cancer progression.
records.model: Castration-resistant prostate cancer genomic and functional models
records.note: RSK1 phosphorylation of TRIM28 promotes an E2F1 positive-feedback loop independent of RB status; RSK inhibition reduces progression. This identifies a cancer vulnerability rather than functional restoration.
records.uncertainty: Specific inhibitor and mode of inhibition are not named.

records.title: Aurora-A promotes the establishment of spindle assembly checkpoint by priming the Haspin-Aurora-B feedback loop in late G2 phase.
records.model: Aurora A knockout, inhibition and nuclear-entry blockade in mitotic cells
records.note: Nuclear Aurora A primes Haspin phosphorylation and Aurora B centromeric recruitment before spindle assembly; its loss or inhibition disrupts this sequence. This identifies an early requirement beyond centrosome functions.
records.uncertainty: No restoration experiment or specific inhibitor identity is supplied.

records.title: Bub1 Facilitates Virus Entry through Endocytosis in a Model of Drosophila Pathogenesis.
records.model: Bub1-deficient Drosophila and mammalian cells under pathogen challenge
records.outcome_direction: reduced pathogen entry and increased survival
records.note: Bub1 deficiency limits clathrin-associated entry of DCV and other pathogens, lowering viral burden and improving fly survival. A cytoplasmic role creates an antiviral genetic-protection route separate from mitotic function.
records.uncertainty: No drug is tested; preserving essential mitotic functions while blocking entry is unresolved.

records.title: The role of peptides in reversing chemoresistance of breast cancer: current facts and future prospects.
records.model: Breast cancer peptide/chemoresistance literature
records.note: Peptide strategies restore chemotherapy susceptibility through cell death, impaired repair, altered microenvironment and drug transport. The abstract names no peptide and concerns tumor control rather than restored healthy-cell function.
records.uncertainty: No individual efficacy experiment can be appraised from this summary.

records.title: Identification and analysis of genes associated with epithelial ovarian cancer by integrated bioinformatics methods.
records.model: Epithelial ovarian cancer public expression and survival datasets
records.note: Network analysis nominates CDC45, CDCA5, KIF4A and ESPL1; lower CDCA5/ESPL1 expression associates with better survival despite complex stage-dependent expression. No intervention is tested.
records.uncertainty: Survival associations do not establish treatment effects.

records.title: Mechanistic redundancy and hierarchy of aging mechanisms: implications for strategies to extend healthspan and biomarker integration.
records.model: Conceptual hierarchy of human aging mechanisms
records.note: The review proposes upstream molecular damage, telomere attrition and sex-hormone decline as drivers, with feedback through secondary processes. Combined prevention and estrogen compensation are proposed without specific tested outcomes.
records.uncertainty: This is a framework, not evidence for an administered healthspan intervention.

records.title: Nuclear transport and the mitotic apparatus: an evolving relationship.
records.model: Nuclear transport and mitosis literature
records.note: The review connects nuclear-pore and transport factors to spindle assembly, kinetochore function and checkpoint signaling. It presents hypotheses about mitotic regulation without a specific rescue.
records.uncertainty: No administered intervention or functional improvement is identified.

records.title: Genomic expression differences between cutaneous cells from red hair color individuals and black hair color individuals based on bioinformatic analysis.
records.model: Red-haired and black-haired cutaneous cells, biopsies and melanomas
records.note: Network-selected genes differ in healthy red-haired skin but not in the compared melanoma tumors, suggesting context-dependent expression linked to MC1R loss-of-function backgrounds.
records.uncertainty: No correction of MC1R or downstream dysfunction is tested.

records.title: Survivin regulates chromosome segregation by modulating the phosphorylation of Aurora B during porcine oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Survivin-depleted porcine oocytes during in vitro maturation
records.note: Survivin RNAi reduces Aurora B phosphorylation and Mad2L1 expression, disrupts homolog separation and prevents polar-body formation. These necessity findings link CPC regulation to meiotic progression.
records.uncertainty: No restorative construct or administered agent is reported.

records.title: Detection of phenotype-specific therapeutic vulnerabilities in breast cells using a CRISPR loss-of-function screen.
records.model: Isogenic epithelial D492 and mesenchymal D492M breast cells with CRISPR screening
