records.note: Genetic screening identifies distinct signaling and mitotic dependencies across epithelial/mesenchymal states; targeted drugs validate vulnerabilities and combination sensitization. The outcomes concern growth suppression, not functional restoration.
records.uncertainty: Applicability to normal tissue or disease correction is not tested.

records.title: miR-125b promotes cell death by targeting spindle assembly checkpoint gene MAD1 and modulating mitotic progression.
records.model: miR-125b-transfected cells and cancer expression comparisons
records.note: Exogenous miR-125b suppresses Mad1, delays metaphase, increases chromosome abnormalities and leads to apoptosis. The inferred need for an optimal Mad1 level does not make this perturbation restorative.
records.uncertainty: No drug or successful correction is described.

records.title: Cyclin A regulates kinetochore microtubules to promote faithful chromosome segregation.
records.model: Cyclin-A-depleted or persistently expressing mitotic cells
records.note: Cyclin A keeps prometaphase kinetochore attachments labile for correction; its destruction permits metaphase stabilization. Depletion stabilizes too early and increases missegregation, while persistence prevents stabilization.
records.uncertainty: This establishes timing-dependent mechanism, not a successful administered rescue.

records.title: Structural Basis for Variations in Polo-like Kinase 1 Conformation and Intracellular Stability Induced by ATP-Competitive and Novel Noncompetitive Abbapolin Inhibitors.
records.model: Cellular PLK1 thermal-shift, binding and localization experiments
records.note: Polo-box ligands stabilize PLK1 thermally yet deplete nuclear protein, whereas kinase-domain inhibitors reduce thermal stability and increase intracellular protein. Catalytic inhibition may leave or enhance noncatalytic functions, complicating target-level interpretation.
records.uncertainty: Clinical inefficacy explanation is a hypothesis; individual compounds and functional consequences need primary detail.

records.title: Stromal Expression of miR-143/145 Promotes Neoangiogenesis in Lung Cancer Development.
records.model: Autochthonous lung adenocarcinoma mice and endothelial-cell experiments
records.outcome_direction: stromal miRNAs promote tumors rather than suppress them
records.note: Tumor-cell miR-143/145 deletion is ineffective, but stromal expression supports endothelial proliferation and angiogenesis through CAMK1D repression. Loss restricts tumors, directly challenging context-free therapeutic delivery of these miRNAs.
records.uncertainty: Previously reported delivery benefits are background; cell-type targeting is decisive.

records.title: Widespread Aberrant Alternative Splicing despite Molecular Remission in Chronic Myeloid Leukaemia Patients.
records.model: CML patient samples at diagnosis/remission and healthy donors
records.note: Expression and methylation largely normalize with TKI-associated remission, yet intron retention and other splicing abnormalities persist or increase, independently of TKI identity. Molecular remission is therefore incomplete at the transcript-processing level.
records.uncertainty: Association cannot distinguish drug effects, residual disease and other causes.

records.title: Family cancer syndromes: inherited deficiencies in systems for the maintenance of genomic integrity.
records.model: Inherited cancer and genome-maintenance literature
records.note: The review uses familial cancer syndromes to explain how failed genome maintenance enables tumor evolution. It does not supply a particular corrective treatment or functional rescue result.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic synthesis alone cannot establish intervention efficacy.

records.title: Comprehensive analyses of telomerase component DKC1 and its association with clinical, molecular and immune landscapes in uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma.
records.model: UCEC tissues and cohorts with hormone-treated UCEC cells
records.outcome_direction: opposing hormonal regulation of DKC1 expression
records.note: Estrogen raises DKC1 whereas medroxyprogesterone lowers it in UCEC cells; elevated tumor DKC1 associates with telomerase, genomic abnormalities and poor outcomes. The hormonal experiment measures expression, not restored function.
records.uncertainty: ICI response relationships are associative and agents are unspecified.

records.title: Illumination of mitotic orchestra during cell division: a Polo view.
records.model: PLK1 spatiotemporal signaling and reporter literature
records.note: The review describes PLK1 priming, activation, shutdown and cross-talk with phosphorylation and ubiquitination, including optical activity sensors. No specific therapeutic rescue is reported.
records.uncertainty: Imaging and mechanistic discussion are not efficacy evidence.

records.title: Tumor environmental factors glucose deprivation and lactic acidosis induce mitotic chromosomal instability--an implication in aneuploid human tumors.
records.model: 4T1, MCF-7 and HCT116 cells under glucose deprivation with lactic acidosis
records.note: Combined nutrient deprivation and lactic acidosis increases micronuclei, aneuploidy and abnormal mitoses, with possible DNA-damage and centrosome mechanisms. This is material evidence that metabolic stress can worsen fidelity.
records.uncertainty: No reversal experiment; individual contributions of glucose and acidity require primary detail.

records.title: Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis Identifies NCAPG2 as an Immune-Related Prognostic Biomarker in Breast Cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer public expression, genomics and clinical datasets
records.note: NCAPG2 elevation associates with aggressive breast cancer features, proliferation/repair programs and immune infiltration/exhaustion markers. The analysis nominates a prognostic marker without perturbation or restoration.
records.uncertainty: Database associations cannot establish therapeutic causality.

records.title: Temporal and SUMO-specific SUMOylation contribute to the dynamics of Polo-like kinase 1 (PLK1) and spindle integrity during mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Mouse meiotic oocytes and PLK1 SUMOylation assays
records.note: PLK1 and phosphorylated PLK1 undergo stage- and SUMO-specific modification; SUMOylation inhibition disrupts bipolar spindles and attachments. Different SUMO forms relate to distinct localization and activity functions.
records.uncertainty: The inhibition method is unspecified; no augmentation rescue is reported.

records.title: Sustainable integrative cell biology: CENP-C is guilty by association.
records.model: Two public pan-cancer proteomic datasets
records.note: CENP-C abundance correlates with cohesin, nuclear-envelope proteins and NuMA, suggesting broader shared pathways. The work demonstrates data-reuse hypotheses rather than causal interaction or correction.
records.uncertainty: Correlated abundance does not prove direct association or functional compensation.

records.title: Signalling dynamics in the spindle checkpoint response.
records.model: Spindle-checkpoint signaling literature
records.note: The review describes checkpoint strength as variable rather than binary and discusses implications for bypass and aneuploidy. It does not provide a particular fidelity-restoring intervention.
records.uncertainty: Conceptual context alone does not establish treatment efficacy.

records.title: The Emerging Role of Chromatin Remodeling Complexes in Ovarian Cancer.
records.model: Chromatin-remodeling complexes in ovarian cancer literature
records.note: The review links remodeling-complex mutations or amplification to ovarian cancer biology and chemoresistance, including ARID1A, SMARCA4, SMARCB1 and RSF1. Specific restorative treatment results are absent.
records.uncertainty: Potential biomarker and target roles remain review-level.

records.title: Identification and comprehensive analysis of circRNA-miRNA-mRNA regulatory networks in osteoarthritis.
records.model: Osteoarthritis expression datasets, docking and expression validation
records.note: A circRNA/miRNA/mRNA network yields candidate biomarkers; docking predicts digitoxin and oxytetracycline affinity for TOP2A and PLK1 respectively. RNA validation does not test either drug.
records.uncertainty: No administered treatment or joint-function benefit is described.

records.title: Comparison Between Familial Colorectal Cancer Type X and Lynch Syndrome: Molecular, Clinical, and Pathological Characteristics and Pedigrees.
records.model: Familial colorectal cancer type X and Lynch-syndrome families
records.note: Panel testing and clinical comparisons identify later onset, rectal preference and lower metachronous CRC frequency in FCCTX than Lynch syndrome. The study informs risk management without an intervention trial.
records.uncertainty: Etiology remains unresolved; surveillance recommendations are not treatment efficacy.

records.title: Patterns of cell cycle checkpoint deregulation associated with intrinsic molecular subtypes of human breast cancer cells.
records.model: 24 breast cancer and immortalized mammary epithelial cell lines
records.note: Functional assessment separates luminal-B decatenation-checkpoint defects from basal-like spindle-checkpoint defects and identifies cohesion abnormalities. Gene signatures associate with outcomes, suggesting heterogeneous vulnerabilities.
records.uncertainty: Pharmacological targeting is proposed; no specific agent or correction result is given.

records.title: Integrative systems immunology uncovers molecular networks of the cell cycle that stratify COVID-19 severity.
records.model: Integrated COVID-19 blood proteome/transcriptome datasets
records.note: Cell-cycle-related molecules differ with COVID-19 severity and trajectory across leukocyte populations. Shared and distinct features versus other respiratory illnesses nominate pathways without intervention evidence.
records.uncertainty: Association does not determine whether changing cell cycling is beneficial.

records.title: A role for Separase in telomere protection.
records.model: Drosophila separase mutants and ESPL1-depleted human primary fibroblasts
records.note: Separase loss reduces HP1 and causes telomere dysfunction; HP1 overexpression suppresses telomeric fusions in fly mutants. Human depletion reproduces HP1 reduction and telomere defects, supporting a potentially conserved compensatory route.
records.uncertainty: Rescue is shown in flies, not human fibroblasts; no drug is tested.

records.title: Cellular senescence in ageing: from mechanisms to therapeutic opportunities.
records.model: Cellular senescence, aging and disease literature
records.note: The review connects senescence and secretory phenotypes with impaired regeneration and aging and surveys intervention opportunities. No named agent or specific functional benefit appears in the abstract.
records.uncertainty: Individual treatment evidence requires sources beyond this broad overview.

records.title: Support for phosphoinositol 3 kinase and mTOR inhibitors as treatment for lupus using in-silico drug-repurposing analysis.
records.model: SLE blood expression signatures and LINCS perturbation data
records.note: Expression matching suggests PI3K and mTOR inhibitors might oppose SLE molecular signatures. The study explicitly frames these as exploratory candidates for future testing.
records.uncertainty: Signature reversal is computational, not observed patient improvement.

records.title: Demethylzeylasteral suppresses the expression of MESP1 by reducing H3K18la level to inhibit the malignant behaviors of pancreatic cancer.
records.model: Pancreatic cancer cells with RNA-seq, ChIP-seq and genetic perturbations
records.outcome_direction: reduced malignant behavior; partial oncogene-expression rescue
records.note: Demethylzeylasteral lowers lactate, H3K18 lactylation and MESP1 expression while suppressing malignant behavior. Sodium lactate partly restores MESP1 expression; this is a mechanistic oncogene readout, not healthy-function restoration.
records.uncertainty: The abstract links MESP1 to both EMT and apoptosis; functional rescue interpretation remains limited.

records.title: Ranking Cancer Proteins by Integrating PPI Network and Protein Expression Profiles.
records.model: CRC and breast cancer proteomics/PPI networks with DepMap validation
records.note: Network ranking improves recovery of disease-related proteins, and many top CRC proteins are required for tumor survival in existing RNAi data. This is target prioritization rather than drug or rescue testing.
records.uncertainty: Dependency evidence concerns malignant-cell survival.

records.title: Genome-wide evidence for an essential role of the human Staf/ZNF143 transcription factor in bidirectional transcription.
records.model: Human bidirectional promoters, binding and reporter assays
records.note: ZNF143 binds and regulates many divergent promoters; intact binding sites and the factor are needed for bidirectional reporter expression. This establishes promoter control without a disease intervention.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or functional restoration is described.

records.title: Identification of Metastasis-Associated Biomarkers in Synovial Sarcoma Using Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Synovial sarcoma public expression and survival datasets
records.note: Integrated analyses identify mitotic and cell-cycle hubs correlated with poor sarcoma survival. The proposed metastasis targets are derived from expression/network relationships, without an intervention test.
records.uncertainty: Upregulation and prognosis do not establish causality or benefit from targeting.

records.title: POLE2 Serves as a Prognostic Biomarker and Is Associated with Immune Infiltration in Squamous Cell Lung Cancer.
records.model: Squamous lung-cancer expression and outcome datasets
records.note: Network analysis identifies survival-associated genes, with POLE2 elevation tracking worse survival and lower immune infiltration. This is biomarker discovery without a functional intervention.
records.uncertainty: Expression association does not establish a treatment target.

records.title: FTH1 Pseudogenes in Cancer and Cell Metabolism.
records.model: Ferritin pseudogene and metabolism literature
records.note: The review classifies ferritin pseudogenes and discusses possible miRNA competition, siRNA generation and protein-coding functions. It does not identify an administered intervention or specific functional restoration.
records.uncertainty: Potential regulatory roles are not efficacy findings.

records.title: Integrated transcriptome expression profiling reveals a novel lncRNA associated with L-DOPA-induced dyskinesia in a rat model of Parkinson's disease.
records.model: Rat Parkinsonism/dyskinesia transcriptomes and in vitro lncRNA knockdown
records.outcome_direction: candidate inflammatory restraint with knockdown harm
records.note: NONRATT023402.2 and candidate targets decrease in disease models; knockdown lowers Gsto2/Ptger3 and promotes inflammation. This suggests a protective lncRNA role without showing therapeutic replacement or dyskinesia rescue.
records.uncertainty: Reported correlation direction is not straightforward; levodopa exposure details are absent.

records.title: Dynamic Interplay of Innate and Adaptive Immunity During Sterile Retinal Inflammation: Insights From the Transcriptome.
records.model: Photo-oxidative retinal injury in rodents and Factor-B-deficient mice
records.note: Factor B deficiency protects against macrophage infiltration and subretinal inflammation following photo-oxidative injury. The study supports complement-pathway protection as a nononcologic route.
records.uncertainty: Preservation of retinal structure or vision is proposed rather than established in this abstract.

records.title: PUNCH-P for global translatome profiling: Methodology, insights and comparison to other techniques.
records.model: Recovered ribosome–nascent-chain complexes from cells or tissues
records.note: PUNCH-P labels newly synthesized proteins for purification and mass-spectrometry analysis, enabling translation-efficiency comparison with mRNA. Puromycin is used analytically, not as a therapeutic treatment.
records.uncertainty: No restorative biological outcome is reported.

records.title: The methyltransferase SETD6 regulates Mitotic progression through PLK1 methylation.
records.model: SETD6-deficient cells and PLK1 methylation-site mutants
records.note: SETD6 methylates PLK1 at K209/K413; loss of this regulation raises kinase activity and speeds mitosis/proliferation. The work identifies a molecular brake on mitotic pace.
records.uncertainty: Normal pace or fidelity is not restored by an intervention in the abstract.

records.title: Loss of cytoplasmic CDK1 predicts poor survival in human lung cancer and confers chemotherapeutic resistance.
records.model: Lung transformation models, tumor microarrays and cancer-cell panels
records.outcome_direction: cytoplasmic CDK1 loss associates with treatment resistance
records.note: Despite elevated tumor CDK1 overall, loss of its cytoplasmic pool predicts poorer survival and chemotherapy resistance. Localization has different implications from total abundance.
records.uncertainty: Perturbation methods and named treatments are absent; no restoration is shown.

records.title: Deletion of APC7 or APC16 Allows Proliferation of Human Cells without the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint.
records.model: Human APC7/APC16 knockouts combined with MAD2 deletion
records.outcome_direction: synthetic viability with residual genome-stability dependence
records.note: Deleting APC7 or APC16 permits survival/proliferation after MAD2 loss while reducing APC/C ubiquitination in vitro. Double-mutant cells still divide rapidly and require checkpoint-independent MPS1 for genome stability.
records.uncertainty: Viability rescue is not restoration of normal fidelity; no administered inhibitor is tested.

records.title: Adenosine-to-inosine editing of miR-200b-3p is associated with the progression of high-grade serous ovarian cancer.
records.model: HGSOC tissues and cultured HGSOC proliferation/migration/spheroids
records.note: Editing switches miR-200b-3p toward enhanced proliferation, migration and spheroid formation, while ADAR1 depletion suppresses those phenotypes. This is cancer-associated RNA-function alteration rather than healthy-function rescue.
records.uncertainty: Predicted new targets and pathway effects do not establish corrective treatment.

records.title: Identifying New Potential Biomarkers in Adrenocortical Tumors Based on mRNA Expression Data Using Machine Learning.
records.model: Adrenocortical tumor transcriptomes with independent cohort validation
records.note: Machine learning recovers known outcome-related ACC subgroups and nominates additional marker genes, with a separate dataset broadly confirming expression patterns. No treatment is tested.
records.uncertainty: Predictive classification is not intervention efficacy.

records.title: Bub3 reads phosphorylated MELT repeats to promote spindle assembly checkpoint signaling.
records.model: Bub3 structure/binding and interface-mutant checkpoint assays
records.outcome_direction: loss of phospho-MELT recognition impairs checkpoint
records.note: Bub3 recognizes phosphorylated KNL1/Spc105 MELT motifs through a conserved interface; mutations disrupt Bub1 recruitment and checkpoint function. This maps a required recruitment mechanism.
records.uncertainty: No engineered or administered restoration is described.

records.title: Pre- and postovulatory aging of murine oocytes affect the transcript level and poly(A) tail length of maternal effect genes.
records.model: Murine oocytes aged before or after ovulation in vivo or in culture
records.note: Preovulatory aging tends to lengthen poly(A) content, whereas postovulatory aging shortens tails on several maternal-effect transcripts. Altered translation timing is proposed to contribute to developmental defects.
records.uncertainty: No functional rescue or treatment is tested.

records.title: BRCA Mutations and Fertility Preservation.
records.model: BRCA-associated fertility and preservation literature
records.note: The review links impaired DNA repair, ovarian aging and heightened treatment-related ovarian depletion in BRCA mutation carriers and discusses fertility preservation. It supplies no particular pharmacological rescue result.
records.uncertainty: Clinical counseling context cannot establish restoration efficacy.

records.title: Triple Negative Breast Cancer Profile, from Gene to microRNA, in Relation to Ethnicity.
records.model: Ethnicity-associated TNBC genomic/miRNA literature
records.note: The review compares genomic and miRNA patterns across ethnic/geographic backgrounds and their potential therapeutic implications. It does not identify a specific administered intervention or correction.
records.uncertainty: Population profile differences are not treatment-response proof.

records.title: Inhibiting the anaphase promoting complex/cyclosome induces a metaphase arrest and cell death in multiple myeloma cells.
records.model: Human myeloma cell lines with Cdc20-knockdown comparison
records.outcome_direction: metaphase arrest and apoptotic cell death
records.note: ProTAME accumulates cyclin B1, arrests metaphase and induces apoptosis, with Bim partly contributing; apcin or melphalan enhances anticancer effects. Cdc20 knockdown phenocopies arrest/death.
records.uncertainty: This is cytotoxic APC/C inhibition, not demonstrated fidelity restoration.

records.title: Adjuvant therapy in adrenocortical carcinoma: prognostic factors and treatment options.
records.model: Adrenocortical carcinoma adjuvant-treatment literature
records.note: The review discusses mitotane evidence, including possible lack of need in low-risk ACC and ongoing high-risk combination evaluation. Radiation and immunotherapy roles remain incompletely established.
records.uncertainty: No new trial or restorative efficacy result is presented.

records.title: An older diabetes-induced mice model for studying skin wound healing.
records.model: Male C57BL/6 mice exposed to prolonged high-fat diet and diabetes induction
records.note: Long obesity exposure followed by streptozotocin produced insulin resistance, glucose intolerance and skin transcriptional changes overlapping elderly diabetic-ulcer patients; no wound-restoring intervention was tested.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not report therapeutic wound-healing improvement or treatment comparisons.

records.title: Spindle checkpoint proteins and chromosome-microtubule attachment in budding yeast.
records.model: Saccharomyces cerevisiae kinetochores during ordinary and damaged mitoses
records.note: Bub1/Bub3 occupied kinetochores during normal early mitosis, whereas Mad1/Mad2 recruitment required spindle damage or attachment lesions; the authors attribute animal–yeast differences to spindle assembly divergence.
records.uncertainty: Species-specific checkpoint behavior does not establish a restorative intervention.

records.title: Sequence-Defined Short Peptide-Derived Coacervate Vesicles for Targeted Therapeutics.

administered_agents.name: Biotin-SR coacervate vesicles loaded with glucose oxidase
administered_agents.role: experimental tumor-targeted therapeutic carrier and enzyme payload

records.model: Cancer spheroids and tumor xenografts
records.note: Enzyme-responsive peptide vesicles released glucose oxidase and coupled glucose depletion, oxidative stress and nitric-oxide-associated mitochondrial dysfunction to tumor suppression.
records.uncertainty: The reported benefit is tumor destruction; no normal-tissue restoration or segregation-fidelity improvement is shown.

records.title: Expressions of Senescence-Associated β-Galactosidase and Senescence Marker Protein-30 are Associated with Lens Epithelial Cell Apoptosis.
records.model: Lens capsule specimens from 145 Chinese patients with age-related cataract
records.note: Senescence-marker expression and epithelial apoptosis differed by capsule location and cataract subtype; cortical cataracts showed more epithelial apoptosis than nuclear cataracts.
records.uncertainty: Cross-sectional tissue associations do not establish causality or an administered intervention.

records.title: Lactylation in tumor: mechanisms and therapeutic potentials.
records.model: Review of lactylation in cancer
records.note: Summarizes lactylation mechanisms and potential diagnostic and therapeutic relevance in tumors without reporting a specific intervention outcome.
records.uncertainty: No directly tested restorative agent is identifiable from this abstract.

records.title: Centromeric Non-coding Transcription: Opening the Black Box of Chromosomal Instability?
records.model: Review of centromeric noncoding RNA and chromosome instability in cancer
records.note: Proposes that deregulated centromeric transcripts contribute to segregation errors despite a functioning spindle checkpoint.
records.uncertainty: The mechanistic proposal is not a demonstrated treatment or correction of instability.

records.title: Lineage-specific roles of the cytoplasmic polyadenylation factor CPEB4 in the regulation of melanoma drivers.
records.model: Melanoma cells, computational/histological analyses and clinical biopsies
records.note: CPEB4 was elevated early in melanoma and supported both mitotic integrity and G1/S progression through lineage-associated networks including MITF and RAB7A.
records.uncertainty: The abstract establishes tumor dependencies, not administered rescue; perturbation details and normal-cell effects are unspecified.

records.title: Safeguarding genetic information in Drosophila.
records.model: Drosophila DNA-damage-response literature
records.note: Reviews interactions between DNA damage responses, spindle-checkpoint components and developmental programming.
records.uncertainty: No specific restoration experiment or administered agent is reported.

records.title: Network Analysis of Effect of Light-Dark Time Ratio on the Gene Expression Profile of Mouse Skin.
records.model: Public mouse-skin expression data comparing Cry1/Cry2-null and wild-type mice at different circadian times
records.note: Network analysis found distinct central genes across circadian sampling groups, indicating strong dependence of skin expression profiles on light/dark timing and cryptochrome status.
records.uncertainty: This secondary analysis does not demonstrate a protective lighting regimen or drug effect.

records.title: Correlation Analysis of Histopathology and Proteogenomics Data for Breast Cancer.
records.model: Matched breast-cancer images, RNA and protein data from 73 TCGA/CPTAC patients
records.note: Morphological features correlated with metabolism, cell-cycle, immune and matrix pathways, with some features also associated with survival.
records.uncertainty: The integrative correlations do not identify causal regulators or test therapy.

records.title: Survivin is not required for the endomitotic cell cycle of megakaryocytes.
records.model: Megakaryocyte-specific survivin deletion in mice and ex vivo megakaryocytes
records.note: Committed megakaryocytes could polyploidize after survivin excision, whereas progenitor survival was impaired; weak in vivo excision limits interpretation of the normal platelet counts.
records.uncertainty: This lineage-specific deletion result is not evidence that a survivin inhibitor restores division or function.

records.title: Schwann cell reprogramming and lung cancer progression: a meta-analysis of transcriptome data.
records.model: Schwann-cell transcriptome meta-analysis integrated with lung-cancer datasets
records.note: Dedifferentiation-related pathways were elevated and migration-inhibiting programs reduced in lung-cancer-associated expression analyses; candidate biomarkers and regulatory miRNAs were proposed.
records.uncertainty: Predicted pathways and prognosis associations require experimental validation; no treatment response was tested.

records.title: Requirements for protein phosphorylation and the kinase activity of polo-like kinase 1 (Plk1) for the kinetochore function of mitotic arrest deficiency protein 1 (Mad1).
records.model: Mitotic cells with Mad1 phosphosite analysis, Plk1 depletion and kinase perturbation
records.note: Mad1 Thr680 phosphorylation supported kinetochore localization and checkpoint activity; Plk1 depletion, kinase-dead expression or pharmacologic inhibition reduced Mad1 phosphorylation and kinetochore association.
records.uncertainty: The inhibitor is unnamed and the abstract gives no dose or restoration experiment; this is potential counterevidence for indiscriminate Plk1 inhibition.

records.title: An antibody-drug conjugate targeting soluble and membrane-bound TGFα is effective against pancreatic tumors.

administered_agents.name: 5F1 and 16B10 TGFalpha antibodies conjugated to MMAF

records.model: Pancreatic-cancer cells and murine tumor models with TGFA genetic controls
records.note: MMAF-bearing TGFalpha antibodies caused mitotic disruption, reduced cancer-cell viability and regressed tumors; unconjugated antibodies stabilized growth.
records.uncertainty: The benefit is antitumor activity and does not indicate normal-cell functional rescue.

records.title: Identification of hub driving genes and regulators of lung adenocarcinoma based on the gene Co-expression network.
records.model: TCGA lung-adenocarcinoma expression/network analyses with external-database checks
records.note: Expression and regulatory-network analyses nominated prognostic genes and regulators, with LRRK2 linked to copy-number changes and immune infiltration.
records.uncertainty: Computational biomarker selection is not interventional efficacy evidence.

records.title: Functional and physical communication between oncoproteins and tumor suppressors.
records.model: Review of oncogenes, tumor suppressors and genomic instability
records.note: Discusses oxidative DNA damage after peroxiredoxin-1 loss or c-Myc increase and their interaction in balancing proliferation against mutagenesis.
records.uncertainty: No specific administered antioxidant or demonstrated restoration is reported.

records.title: Genome-wide RNAi screens in human brain tumor isolates reveal a novel viability requirement for PHF5A.
records.model: Patient-derived glioblastoma stem cells, nontransformed controls and xenografts
records.note: PHF5A loss disrupted recognition of unusual splice sites and selectively compromised glioblastoma stem-cell viability; U2 snRNP inhibition reproduced the cellular phenotype, including in MYC-overexpressing controls.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not specify the inhibitor or whether the in vivo PHF5A intervention was pharmacologic; effects are tumor dependency and killing, not restoration.

records.title: Integrated analysis of tumor differentiation genes in pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
records.model: TCGA pancreatic-adenocarcinoma expression and survival datasets
records.note: Differentiation-associated expression patterns and survival analyses nominated a set of pancreatic-cancer biomarkers, with electronic validation of selected trends.
records.uncertainty: No administered intervention or causal differentiation rescue was tested.

records.title: Plasma Extracellular MicroRNAs Associated With Cardiovascular Disease Risk Factors in Middle-Aged and Older Adults.
records.model: Framingham Heart Study plasma from 4440 participants with replication in 1999 Rotterdam participants
records.note: Several extracellular miRNAs associated with cardiovascular risk factors, with partial replication and additional prospective mortality associations.
records.uncertainty: Associations and predicted targets do not establish therapeutic miRNA manipulation or improved function.

records.title: Effects of aging on angiogenesis.
records.model: Literature on age-related endothelial dysfunction and angiogenesis
records.note: Reviews mechanisms of impaired angiogenesis in aging and discusses therapeutic improvement of vascular repair as a general aim.
records.uncertainty: No specific intervention or experimental restoration result appears in the saved abstract.

records.title: Search for rare protein altering variants influencing susceptibility to multiple myeloma.
records.model: Exome sequencing of 513 multiple-myeloma cases and 1569 controls
records.note: No recurrent low-frequency coding allele achieved the stated association criterion; a KIF18A gene-burden signal and expression/survival patterns were considered promising.
records.uncertainty: The candidate association is not validated causal susceptibility or intervention efficacy.

records.title: Identification of HCG18 and MCM3AP-AS1 That Associate With Bone Metastasis, Poor Prognosis and Increased Abundance of M2 Macrophage Infiltration in Prostate Cancer.
records.model: Public primary and bone-metastatic prostate-cancer transcriptomes with network and drug-database analyses
records.note: HCG18 and MCM3AP-AS1 networks associated with prognosis and macrophage infiltration; database queries proposed valproic acid and trichostatin A as candidate treatments.
records.uncertainty: Neither proposed drug was administered in the reported analysis, and the predictions concern cancer metastasis.

records.title: Identification of Maturation-Specific Proteins by Single-Cell Proteomics of Human Oocytes.
records.model: Proteomic and secretomic analysis of human oocytes, including individual immature and mature cells
records.note: A single-oocyte workflow distinguished maturation-associated proteins and highlighted genome-maintenance factors in mature oocytes.
records.uncertainty: Proteomic enrichment does not demonstrate that administering a compound improves oocyte maturation or fidelity.

records.title: Maternal mRNAs with distinct 3' UTRs define the temporal pattern of Ccnb1 synthesis during mouse oocyte meiotic maturation.
records.model: Mouse oocyte meiotic maturation and Ccnb1 transcript regulation
records.note: Alternative Ccnb1 3-prime UTRs produced different timing of translational activation or repression, adding a mechanism controlling meiotic progression.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or disease rescue is reported.

records.title: Tumor antigen acrosin binding protein normalizes mitotic spindle function to promote cancer cell proliferation.
records.model: Ovarian-cancer cell lines, tumor explants and patient correlations
records.note: ACRBP supported paclitaxel resistance and spindle integrity; loss of ACRBP caused mitotic errors and reduced proliferation that NuMA codepletion rescued.
records.uncertainty: The restoration is genetic and tumor-context dependent; paclitaxel is the damaging challenge, not the rescuing treatment.

records.title: Caveolins in rhabdomyosarcoma.
records.model: Caveolin expression in skeletal-muscle differentiation and rhabdomyosarcoma
records.note: Reviews caveolins as differentiation markers and possible regulators of rhabdomyosarcoma progression, alongside their normal muscle expression patterns.
records.uncertainty: No administered muscle-restoring agent or functional rescue outcome is specified.

records.title: Integrated cross-species transcriptional network analysis of metastatic susceptibility.
records.model: Two human breast-cancer datasets and three mouse metastasis populations
records.note: Cross-species network signatures associated with metastasis-free survival and implicated tumor-autonomous spindle-checkpoint programs in estrogen-receptor-positive disease.
records.uncertainty: Conserved predictive networks do not prove intervention benefit or checkpoint restoration.

records.title: Role of the bHLH transcription factor TCF21 in development and tumorigenesis.
records.model: TCF21 literature on organ development and cancer
records.note: Discusses developmental transcriptional control and loss or epigenetic inactivation of TCF21 in cancer.
records.uncertainty: No specific administered reactivation treatment or restoration result is given.

records.title: Mps1 promotes rapid centromere accumulation of Aurora B.
records.model: Mitotic centromere recruitment and chromosome-biorientation experiments
records.note: Mps1 promoted the Bub1/H2A/shugoshin recruitment pathway, and restoring centromeric Aurora B improved biorientation defects caused by Mps1 inhibition.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not name the Mps1 inhibitor or the method used to restore Aurora B; pharmacologic rescue must not be assumed.

records.title: Potential of modern circulating cell-free DNA diagnostic tools for detection of specific tumour cells in clinical practice.
records.model: Circulating tumor-DNA diagnostics and companion tests
records.note: Surveys DNA detection technologies, diagnostic development and companion-test concepts for precision cancer care.
records.uncertainty: Mentions of approved tests and linked drugs are background, with no restoration efficacy experiment.

records.title: Transcriptome profiling revealed multiple genes and ECM-receptor interaction pathways that may be associated with breast cancer.
records.model: Breast tumors and adjacent tissues from six patients with expression checks in eight additional clinical specimens
records.note: Tumor expression profiling implicated cell adhesion and ECM-receptor pathways and validated selected upregulated and downregulated genes.
records.uncertainty: Expression changes alone do not show therapeutic correction of the pathways.

records.title: Centrosomes and myeloma; aneuploidy and proliferation.
records.model: Multiple-myeloma centrosome amplification and genomic instability
records.note: Describes centrosome amplification as a possible contributor to myeloma instability and a marker of adverse disease features.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not report an intervention reducing centrosome amplification or improving function.

records.title: Comparative proteomic analysis uncovers potential biomarkers involved in the anticancer effect of Scutellarein in human gastric cancer cells.
records.model: AGS and SNU484 human gastric-cancer cells
records.note: Proteomics and immunoblotting linked scutellarein exposure to reduced PIK3CB and CIP2A, supporting its reported apoptosis and growth-inhibition phenotype.
records.uncertainty: Candidate response biomarkers and docking do not demonstrate normal-tissue restoration.

records.title: Emi1 stably binds and inhibits the anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome as a pseudosubstrate inhibitor.
records.model: Emi1–APC/C biochemical binding and mutational experiments
records.note: Emi1 combined a destruction-box binding site with a zinc-dependent anti-ligase function to inhibit APC/C, and zinc-region mutation converted it into a degradable substrate.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic agent or functional rescue in a deficient model is reported.

records.title: PP6 regulation of Aurora A-TPX2 limits NDC80 phosphorylation and mitotic spindle size
records.model: PPP6C-knockout cells with NDC80 phosphosite mutation
records.note: PP6 loss increased Aurora-A-associated NDC80 phosphorylation and spindle size; phosphorylation-deficient NDC80-9A reduced spindle enlargement and abnormal nuclear structure.
records.uncertainty: This saved record is a preprint; rescue is a genetic phosphosite alteration, not demonstrated drug treatment.

records.title: Gene set enrichment analysis and meta-analysis identified 12 key genes regulating and controlling the prognosis of lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Lung-adenocarcinoma microarray meta-analysis and TCGA survival data
records.note: Gene-set and survival analyses nominated cell-cycle and replication genes, including BUB1B, for later experimental testing.
records.uncertainty: The authors explicitly leave biological functions to future confirmation; no intervention was tested.

records.title: Mad2B forms a complex with Cdc20, Cdc27, Rev3 and Rev1 in response to cisplatin-induced DNA damage.
records.model: Human cancer cells and in vitro ubiquitination assays
records.note: Cisplatin recruited Mad2B and Cdc20 into DNA-damage-associated complexes, with assays supporting Mad2B-dependent APC/C activation.
records.uncertainty: Activation during drug-induced damage is mechanistic evidence, not proof of restored fidelity or survival benefit.

records.title: ASPM promotes the progression of ovarian endometriosis by modulating the cell cycle and activating the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway.
records.model: Endometriosis tissues and primary endometrial stromal cells
records.note: ASPM depletion reduced proliferation, invasion and migration and caused G1 arrest; Wnt/beta-catenin inhibition opposed ASPM overexpression effects.
records.uncertainty: The inhibitory modality is not specified and the phenotype concerns pathological stromal expansion, without functional tissue restoration.

records.title: Androgen receptor splicing variant 7 (ARV7) inhibits docetaxel sensitivity by inactivating the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: ARV7-expressing prostate-cancer cells
records.note: ARV7–UBE2C signaling weakened the checkpoint and favored mitotic escape from docetaxel; blocking mitotic exit enhanced docetaxel effects.
records.uncertainty: The inhibitor is unnamed and the combination endpoint is tumor-cell sensitivity, not correction of chromosome segregation in healthy cells.

records.title: Nicotinic acid protects germinal vesicle oocyte meiosis against toxicity of benzo(a)pyrene in mice and humans.
records.model: Mouse and human germinal-vesicle oocytes during in vitro maturation
records.note: Nicotinic acid increased Sirt1 expression and rescued many BaP-associated abnormalities in mouse oocytes, including a maturation-defect context, and partially protected maturation and mitochondrial/oxidative phenotypes in human oocytes.
records.uncertainty: The abstract reports partial toxicant protection ex vivo, not inherited BUB1B correction, muscle efficacy or clinical fertility improvement.

records.title: BUB1 and CENP-U, Primed by CDK1, Are the Main PLK1 Kinetochore Receptors in Mitosis.
records.model: Human kinetochore localization, ectopic recruitment and reconstituted binding experiments
records.note: BUB1 and CENP-U accounted for kinetochore PLK1 recruitment through neighboring docking motifs whose binding depended on kinase priming.
records.uncertainty: No drug-mediated compensation or rescue is described.

records.title: Association of genetic variation in mitotic kinases with breast cancer risk.
records.model: Genotyping of 798 breast-cancer cases and 843 controls
records.note: Several mitotic-kinase variants associated with cancer risk, with FYN signals remaining of interest after multiple-testing adjustment.
records.uncertainty: Replication was still required; the cited Drosophila depletion experiments are background rather than a human intervention.

records.title: A chemical-genetic system to rapidly inhibit the PP2A-B56 phosphatase reveals a role at metaphase kinetochores.

administered_agents.name: unnamed recruitment-inducing drug
administered_agents.role: chemical trigger for engineered directSLiM recruitment

records.model: Chemical-genetic inhibition of PP2A-B56 during mitosis
records.note: Rapidly blocking B56 binding interfaces revealed a requirement for PP2A-B56 in metaphase tension sensing and maintenance of kinetochore–microtubule attachments.
records.uncertainty: The compound acts through an engineered system; neither a conventional selective inhibitor nor a restorative drug is established.

records.title: Aurora kinase-A inactivates DNA damage-induced apoptosis and spindle assembly checkpoint response functions of p73.
records.model: Tumor cells expressing p73 phosphomimetic mutant and primary tumor observations
records.note: Aurora-A-linked p73 phosphorylation promoted cytoplasmic sequestration, MAD2–CDC20 dissociation and premature mitotic exit; the phosphomimetic also resisted cisplatin-induced apoptosis.
records.uncertainty: The abstract tests a damaging signaling state and mutant, not pharmacologic reversal.

records.title: An Analysis of Clinical and Pathologic Features, RecurIndex Genomic Profiles, and Survival Outcomes in HER2-Low Breast Cancer.
records.model: Retrospective RecurIndex data from 165 early breast-cancer patients
records.note: HER2-low tumors differed in receptor status, proliferation markers and expression profiles, with relapse associations depending on hormone-receptor context.
records.uncertainty: Antibody-drug-conjugate benefit is background; this cohort analysis does not test such treatment.

records.title: Germline Variants in DNA Damage Repair Genes: An Emerging Role in the Era of Precision Medicine in Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Pancreatic-adenocarcinoma germline DNA-repair variants and precision oncology literature
records.note: Reviews how repair-gene variants could stratify cancer treatment, referencing checkpoint immunotherapy and PARP-inhibitor trials.
records.uncertainty: Pembrolizumab and PARP inhibitors are contextual treatment examples, with no direct restoration experiment reported here.

records.title: Identifying key genes and small molecule compounds for nasopharyngeal carcinoma by various bioinformatic analysis.
records.model: Nasopharyngeal-carcinoma expression datasets and drug-signature databases
records.note: Expression/network analyses proposed piperlongumine, apigenin, menadione, 1,4-chrysenequinone and chrysin as possible anticancer compounds.
records.uncertainty: The agents were computational nominations, not administered treatments with observed benefit.

records.title: Chromothripsis: an emerging crossroad from aberrant mitosis to therapeutic opportunities.
records.model: Chromothripsis and aberrant-mitosis literature
records.note: Reviews micronuclei, chromosome bridges, repair and mitotic-checkpoint pathways as sources and possible targets of chromothripsis.
records.uncertainty: The abstract identifies no concrete administered treatment or corrected functional endpoint.

records.title: Endothelial Differentiation G Protein-Coupled Receptor 5 Plays an Important Role in Induction and Maintenance of Pluripotency.
records.model: Human somatic-cell reprogramming and embryonic stem-cell maintenance
records.note: EDG5 depletion disrupted actin organization, focal adhesions and colony integrity and reduced successful reprogramming, implicating the RhoA–ROCK–cofilin pathway.
records.uncertainty: A requirement for endogenous EDG5 is shown; receptor agonist benefit or restored function is not tested.

records.title: Transcriptome Analysis of Transiently Reversible Cell Vacuolization Caused by Excessive Serum Concentration in Scophthalmus maximus.

administered_agents.name: trypsin
administered_agents.role: routine dissociation reagent used before passage

records.model: Scophthalmus maximus head-kidney cell line
records.note: High-serum culture produced vacuolization with increased mitotic and stress-related transcripts; vacuoles receded after trypsinization and passage.
records.uncertainty: Passage changes multiple culture conditions, so the reversal cannot be assigned to a restorative drug mechanism.

records.title: Central role for cholangiocyte pathobiology in cholestatic liver diseases.
records.model: Cholangiocyte signaling in chronic cholestatic liver diseases
records.note: Reviews senescent cholangiocyte signaling and interactions with fibroblasts and immune cells during biliary injury and fibrosis.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not specify a tested treatment or functional recovery outcome.

records.title: Saturated fatty acid metabolism is key link between cell division, cancer, and senescence in cellular and whole organism aging.
records.model: Literature on senescence, fatty-acid metabolism and organismal aging
records.note: Proposes a shared aging/senescence pathway involving p53, lipid-enzyme repression and palmitate accumulation, with calorie restriction discussed as a contrasting metabolic context.
records.uncertainty: The causal unification is a review conclusion; no named administered restorative agent is tested.

records.title: CenpH regulates meiotic G2/M transition by modulating the APC/CCdh1-cyclin B1 pathway in oocytes.
records.model: Mouse meiotic oocytes depleted of CenpH by morpholino
records.note: CenpH depletion lowered cyclin B1 and impaired meiotic entry, while exogenous cyclin B1 restored G2/M transition; post-breakdown spindle organization was unaffected.
records.uncertainty: The rescue uses expression of a cell-cycle protein, not an administered small molecule; normal mature-egg competence is not established.

records.title: The Potential for Targeting G<sub>2</sub>/M Cell Cycle Checkpoint Kinases in Enhancing the Efficacy of Radiotherapy.
records.model: Cancer radiotherapy and Chk1/Wee1 inhibition literature
records.note: Discusses disabling the remaining G2/M checkpoint to radiosensitize tumors with defective earlier checkpoints.
records.uncertainty: The aim is damage-driven cancer-cell death; no named agent or normal-tissue restoration result is provided.

records.title: The cell cycle as a therapeutic target against Trypanosoma brucei: Hesperadin inhibits Aurora kinase-1 and blocks mitotic progression in bloodstream forms.
records.model: Trypanosoma brucei enzyme assays and cultured bloodstream forms; genetic infection model in mice
records.note: Hesperadin inhibited TbAUK1-associated phosphorylation and parasite growth at nanomolar concentrations and blocked nuclear division and cytokinesis.
records.uncertainty: The infection evidence was from genetic depletion, not stated drug dosing in infected mice; the cellular effect disrupts division rather than restores it.

records.title: Identification and validation of real hub genes in hepatocellular carcinoma based on weighted gene co-expression network analysis.
records.model: TCGA/GEO hepatocellular-carcinoma expression and survival analyses
records.note: Coexpression and survival analyses nominated CDK1, CCNA2 and CDC20 as overexpressed adverse-prognosis markers.
records.uncertainty: Database corroboration does not establish that treating these targets benefits a disease model.

records.title: Tissue specific LRRK2 interactomes reveal a distinct striatal functional unit.
records.model: LRRK2 interaction network integrated with expression in 15 healthy tissue types
records.note: Tissue expression patterns distinguished a striatal LRRK2 interaction cluster and provided a resource for context-specific hypotheses.
records.uncertainty: No Parkinsonian functional rescue or inhibitor effect was measured.

records.title: Ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis of KNL2 driven by APC/CCDC20 is critical for centromere integrity and mitotic fidelity.
records.model: Arabidopsis KNL2 regulation with nematode interaction data
records.note: Proteasome inhibitors increased KNL2 abundance, while APC/C depletion disrupted its localization; a degradation-resistant plant KNL2 variant impaired division, growth and fertility.
records.uncertainty: Severe phenotypes came from a genetic stable variant, not directly demonstrated inhibitor toxicity; cross-species relevance requires primary inspection.

records.title: PP6 regulation of Aurora A-TPX2 limits NDC80 phosphorylation and mitotic spindle size.
records.model: PPP6C-knockout cells with NDC80 phosphorylation-site mutation
records.note: Loss of PP6 enlarged spindles through elevated Aurora-A-dependent NDC80 phosphorylation; NDC80-9A reduced spindle size and nuclear-structure defects.
records.uncertainty: Published counterpart of the selected preprint PPR496851; it is the same genetic rescue line, not independent drug efficacy.

records.title: Integrated Analysis To Identify Molecular Biomarkers Of High-Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer.
records.model: Integrated high-grade serous ovarian-cancer datasets with RNA/protein validation
records.note: Expression and survival analyses nominated MELK, CEP55 and KDR as possible prognostic or diagnostic markers.
records.uncertainty: Expression validation does not test treatment or causal rescue.

records.title: Cell-Cycle Cross Talk with Caspases and Their Substrates.
records.model: Caspase interactions with differentiation and cell-cycle regulation
records.note: Surveys nonapoptotic caspase roles in progenitor differentiation, proliferation, arrest and senescence, including skeletal myoblasts.
records.uncertainty: No specific caspase-modulating treatment or muscle-function improvement is reported.

records.title: The Role of the APC/C and Its Coactivators Cdh1 and Cdc20 in Cancer Development and Therapy.
records.model: APC/C, Cdh1 and Cdc20 in tumor development
records.note: Reviews cell-cycle proteolysis, contrasting tumor-related roles of Cdh1 and Cdc20 and possible target-directed oncology approaches.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or demonstrated restorative endpoint is named.

records.title: Identification of Key Candidate Genes and Pathways in Colorectal Cancer by Integrated Bioinformatical Analysis.
records.model: Four colorectal-cancer expression cohorts totaling 319 tumors and 103 normal mucosa samples
records.note: Integrated profiles and interaction modules highlighted cell-cycle, chemokine and GPCR genes as candidate disease pathways.
records.uncertainty: Putative therapeutic targets were inferred from expression, without treatment experiments.

records.title: A pan-cancer modular regulatory network analysis to identify common and cancer-specific network components.
records.model: TCGA regulatory-network analysis across six cancer types
records.note: A modular inference method identified shared immune, cell-cycle and chromatin-regulation programs and candidate cancer-specific hubs.
records.uncertainty: Network predictions do not constitute restoration or administered-drug evidence.

records.title: Developmentally regulated GTPases: structure, function and roles in disease.
records.model: DRG1/DRG2 GTPases and DFRP binding partners
records.note: Reviews the structures and biochemical roles of poorly characterized GTPases implicated in translation, microtubules and proliferation.
records.uncertainty: No administered intervention or restoration outcome is reported.

records.title: The molecular basis of genistein-induced mitotic arrest and exit of self-renewal in embryonal carcinoma and primary cancer cell lines.
records.model: Primary glioblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma and hepatocellular-carcinoma cells plus NCCIT cells
records.note: Genistein arrested the cancer models at different checkpoints, reduced selected mitotic/self-renewal factors and induced stress/apoptosis-associated proteins.
records.uncertainty: Cancer-cell arrest and loss of self-renewal do not establish normal muscle or mitotic restoration.

records.title: Shared molecular and cellular mechanisms of premature ageing and ageing-associated diseases.
records.model: Premature-aging disorders, using Hutchinson–Gilford progeria as a paradigm
records.note: Connects premature aging to common disease through genome, metabolism, mitochondrial, proteostasis and stem-cell defects.
records.uncertainty: The saved abstract gives no specific therapeutic result for appraisal.

records.title: Integrated genomics and comprehensive validation reveal drivers of genomic evolution in esophageal adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Esophageal-adenocarcinoma integrated genomics, perturbation screens and functional validation
records.note: TTK, TPX2 and RAD54B perturbations linked these genes to DNA damage, recombination and genomic instability; the authors propose TTK inhibition to reduce spontaneous and chemotherapy-associated instability.
records.uncertainty: A concrete inhibitor regimen and its measured effects are not specified in the abstract; primary inspection is needed to separate demonstrated suppression from therapeutic extrapolation.

records.title: Construction of a disease-specific lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA regulatory network reveals potential regulatory axes and prognostic biomarkers for hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: TCGA hepatocellular-carcinoma ceRNA network and survival modeling
records.note: Integrated RNA networks produced candidate regulatory axes and a CRNDE/MYLK-AS1/CHEK1 prognostic signature.
records.uncertainty: Prediction-model performance and inferred targets do not demonstrate treatment benefit.

records.title: BRCA1: cell cycle checkpoint, genetic instability, DNA damage response and cancer evolution.
records.model: BRCA1 checkpoint, DNA-damage-response and tumor-evolution literature
records.note: Describes checkpoint and centrosome defects following BRCA1 loss and growth-suppressive damage responses that constrain subsequent tumor evolution.
records.uncertainty: No administered compensatory treatment is identified.

records.title: The COMA complex interacts with Cse4 and positions Sli15/Ipl1 at the budding yeast inner kinetochore.
records.model: Budding-yeast inner kinetochore reconstitution and targeting mutants
records.note: COMA bound CENP-A nucleosomes and the Aurora-B-containing passenger complex; tethering Sli15 to Ame1/Okp1 rescued a synthetic-lethal combination of targeting defects.
records.uncertainty: The result is engineered recruitment in yeast, not drug restoration or evidence in human BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: EPEN-13. PRIMARY EXTRADURAL SACROCOCCYGEAL SUBCUTANEOUS MYXOPAPILAR EPENDYMOMA MISDIAGNOSED AS PILONIDAL CYST IN A 7 YEAR-OLD BOY: A CASE REPORT
records.model: Seven-year-old boy with extradural sacrococcygeal myxopapillary ependymoma
records.note: After earlier misdiagnosis and recurrent masses, complete tumor removal was followed by three years without reported recurrence, without chemotherapy or radiotherapy.
records.uncertainty: A single surgical case provides no restorative pharmacology evidence or long-term cure guarantee.

records.title: An unexpected role for BAG3 in regulating PARP1 ubiquitination in oxidative stress-related endothelial damage.
records.model: Endothelial-specific BAG3 mouse models and protein-modification experiments
records.note: BAG3 overexpression lessened oxidative endothelial injury and vascular remodeling, opposite to knockout; mechanistic work linked deacetylated BAG3 to WWP2-dependent PARP1 degradation.
records.uncertainty: Protection was genetic; no BAG3, SIRT2 or PARP1 drug intervention is specified.

records.title: Morphological and stage-specific transcriptome analyses reveal distinct regulatory programs underlying yam (Dioscorea alata L.) bulbil growth.
records.model: Yam bulbil development with histology, transcriptomes and hormone measurements
records.note: Developmental stages had coordinated cell-growth, auxin and sugar-signaling expression patterns, with candidate initiation regulators inferred.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not establish administered hormone or sugar rescue, and this is plant developmental biology.

records.title: Cellular Mechanisms of Ciliary Length Control.
records.model: Ciliogenesis, centriole maturation and ciliary-length regulation
records.note: Reviews coordination of basal-body docking, intraflagellar transport and assembly/disassembly balance in cilium formation.
records.uncertainty: No treatment or corrected ciliopathy outcome appears in the abstract.

records.title: Applying NGS Data to Find Evolutionary Network Biomarkers from the Early and Late Stages of Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: Early- and late-stage hepatocellular-carcinoma sequencing/network models
records.note: Stage-specific interaction networks highlighted mismatch repair early and spliceosome, lysine and other pathways later in tumor evolution.
records.uncertainty: Therapeutic relevance is a hypothesis from network modeling, not tested efficacy.

records.title: The ternary complex factor protein ELK1 is an independent prognosticator of disease recurrence in prostate cancer.
records.model: TCGA prostate-cancer cohort of 501 patients with transcriptional activity assays
records.note: ELK1, unlike ELK3/ELK4, independently associated with recurrence and improved discrimination when added to existing prognostic gene panels.
records.uncertainty: Resistance-related treatments are background; the study does not test ELK1-directed therapy.

records.title: Amitozyn impairs chromosome segregation and induces apoptosis via mitotic checkpoint activation.
records.model: HeLa and other transformed cell lines plus tubulin-polymerization assays
records.note: Amitozyn reversibly disrupted microtubules, produced abnormal mitoses and triggered apoptosis, including in several drug-resistant cancer-cell settings.
records.uncertainty: Reversibility refers to drug effects after exposure, not repaired segregation fidelity; antitumor cytotoxicity is the reported aim.

records.title: Kinetochore assembly: if you build it, they will come.
records.model: Kinetochore assembly and centromere specification literature
records.note: Summarizes emerging mechanisms coordinating kinetochore assembly with the cell cycle.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent or functional rescue is described.

records.title: Centrosome associated genes pattern for risk sub-stratification in multiple myeloma.
records.model: Myeloma plasma cells from 151 patients split into training and validation cohorts
records.note: A 12-gene centrosome-related expression pattern refined risk classification beyond selected existing categories.
records.uncertainty: Prognostic stratification does not provide evidence that targeting those genes improves outcomes.

records.title: The promoters of human cell cycle genes integrate signals from two tumor suppressive pathways during cellular transformation.
records.model: Controlled in vitro transformation with p53/p16 pathway perturbation
records.note: Expression profiles and promoter experiments showed how p53 and p16 signals combine to regulate cell-cycle genes, with p21, NFY and E2F required for selected p53 repression effects.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacologic restoration or deficient-tissue function was tested.

records.title: Localized Aurora B activity spatially controls non-kinetochore microtubules during spindle assembly.
records.model: Mitotic spindle microtubule plus-end localization experiments
records.note: Chromosome-proximal Aurora B activity limited MCAK accumulation at nearby microtubule ends, supplying a mechanism for spatial regulation of spindle dynamics.
records.uncertainty: This identifies endogenous regulation without demonstrating an administered rescue.

records.title: The Microtubule-Depolymerizing Activity of a Mitotic Kinesin Protein KIF2A Drives Primary Cilia Disassembly Coupled with Cell Proliferation.
records.model: KIF2A-deficient hTERT-RPE1 cells and cells from premature-chromatid-separation syndrome patients
records.note: PLK1 phosphorylation activated KIF2A-dependent ciliary disassembly; persistent activation of this pathway was linked causally to deficient ciliogenesis in patient cells.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not specify a drug or explicit rescue protocol; inspect the primary study for whether pathway suppression restored cilia.

records.title: System level identification and multidimensional analysis of hub genes reveal complex regulatory networks underlying human iPSC differentiation into motor neurons.
records.model: Public human iPSC-to-motor-neuron differentiation transcriptomes at day 28
records.note: Multilayer bioinformatics nominated cell-cycle hubs and regulatory motifs associated with motor-neuron differentiation.
records.uncertainty: The authors emphasize that computational findings require experimental validation; no improved differentiation intervention was tested.

records.title: Screening Key Pathogenic Genes and Small Molecule Compounds for PNET.
records.model: Two primitive-neuroectodermal-tumor expression datasets and CMap predictions
records.note: Network analysis nominated mitotic hubs and proposed trichostatin A, luteolin, repaglinide, clomipramine, lorglumide, vorinostat and resveratrol as candidates.
records.uncertainty: No nominated agent was administered; predicted reversal of a tumor signature is not demonstrated functional restoration.

records.title: Liver Fibrosis and Inflammation under the Control of ERK2.
records.model: ERK2-deficient and wild-type mice with diet-induced liver injury
records.note: ERK2 deficiency reduced fibrosis markers, injury-associated proliferation and activated T-cell proportions compared with wild type.
records.uncertainty: Benefits arose from genetic deficiency; an ERK inhibitor regimen and improved liver-function result are not explicitly reported.

records.title: CDK1-mediated mitotic phosphorylation of PBK is involved in cytokinesis and inhibits its oncogenic activity.
records.model: PBK phosphosite mutants in breast-cancer and immortalized epithelial cells
records.note: CDK1 phosphorylated PBK at several sites, and the T9A mutant altered cytokinesis-related regulation and increased tumorigenic behavior.
records.uncertainty: Mitotic-arrest drugs served as tools; no agent was shown to restore cytokinesis or suppress disease through this phosphorylation.

records.title: Centrosome amplification: a quantifiable cancer cell trait with prognostic value in solid malignancies.
records.model: Centrosome-amplification measurement and prognosis across solid cancers
records.note: Reviews a quantitative centrosome score and correlations between amplification severity, disease progression and poor prognosis.
records.uncertainty: A measurement/biomarker framework does not establish a therapeutic correction.

records.title: Oral administration of Lactobacillus plantarum 299v modulates gene expression in the ileum of pigs: prediction of crosstalk between intestinal immune cells and sub-mucosal adipocytes.
records.model: Six-week-old pigs with pooled intestinal transcript profiling
records.note: Oral probiotic dosing altered ileal immune and metabolic transcripts, including reduced adenosine deaminase expression, motivating proposed anti-inflammatory crosstalk.
records.uncertainty: Reduced inflammation was inferred from expression rather than demonstrated as a functional disease endpoint in the abstract.

records.title: Weighted Gene Co-Expression Network Analysis Based on Stimulation by Lipopolysaccharides and Polyinosinic:polycytidylic Acid Provides a Core Set of Genes for Understanding Hemolymph Immune Response Mechanisms of Amphioctopus fangsiao.
records.model: Amphioctopus fangsiao hemolymph transcriptomes within 24 hours
records.note: Immune stimulation produced coexpression modules and hub genes including PKMYT1 and NAMPT in octopus hemolymph.
records.uncertainty: The stimuli model infection; they are not tested protective treatments or evidence of functional rescue.

records.title: Loss of aquaporin-4 expression and putative function in non-small cell lung cancer.
records.model: 576 normal-lung and non-small-cell-lung-cancer expression samples with tissue validation
records.note: Aquaporin expression differed across tissue and tumor subtypes; higher AQP4 in well-differentiated adenocarcinoma associated with more favorable prognosis.
records.uncertainty: The abstract cautions that functional redundancy remains unresolved; no aquaporin-modulating treatment was tested.

records.title: Enrichment of Aurora B kinase at the inner kinetochore controls outer kinetochore assembly.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts and reconstituted kinetochore biochemistry
records.note: Local enrichment of Aurora B and CENP-C cooperatively enhanced Dsn1 phosphorylation and outer-kinetochore assembly; INCENP also supported checkpoint signaling.
records.uncertainty: This endogenous assembly mechanism is not a demonstrated disease-rescue treatment.

records.title: Biomolecular events in cancer revealed by attractor metagenes.
records.model: Gene-expression datasets from multiple cancer types
records.note: An iterative method recovered shared mesenchymal, chromosomal-instability and lymphocyte expression signatures correlated with tumor features.
records.uncertainty: The signatures identify associations, not perturbations that correct instability.

records.title: Genetic landscape and functional exploration of kidney cancer predisposition in cross-ancestral populations.
records.model: Multi-ancestry renal-cancer GWAS, kidney eQTLs and CRISPR functional validation
records.note: Large genetic analyses identified susceptibility loci and supported an RPL4-related risk association through functional screening.
records.uncertainty: No drug intervention or restorative phenotype is reported.

records.title: Signature Genes Selection and Functional Analysis of Astrocytoma Phenotypes: A Comparative Study.
records.model: Grade 2/3 astrocytoma transcriptomes from the Rembrandt repository
records.note: Different feature-selection methods improved classification but selected nonoverlapping gene sets and inconsistent pathway enrichments, exposing sensitivity of biological inference to analysis choices.
records.uncertainty: This is methodological evidence, without therapeutic testing.

records.title: Integrated Network Analysis Reveals FOXM1 and MYBL2 as Key Regulators of Cell Proliferation in Non-small Cell Lung Cancer.
records.model: Non-small-cell-lung-cancer expression meta-analysis and interaction networks
records.note: A proliferation-focused network under predicted FOXM1/MYBL2 regulation associated with poorer survival.
records.uncertainty: The driver designation is computational; no causal or drug rescue was demonstrated.

records.title: Targeting karyotypic complexity and chromosomal instability of cancer cells.
records.model: Cancer karyotypic complexity and treatment-selection concepts
records.note: Proposes exploiting tumor-specific chromosome abnormalities as druggable states and using karyotype to guide therapy development.
records.uncertainty: The abstract contains no tested compound or improvement in segregation fidelity.

records.title: Carcinogenesis effects of E2F transcription factor 8 (E2F8) in hepatocellular carcinoma outcomes: an integrated bioinformatic report.
records.model: Public hepatocellular-carcinoma expression, clinical and survival databases
records.note: Higher E2F8 expression associated with tumor features and poorer survival across several outcomes, with enrichment for cell-cycle programs.
records.uncertainty: Associations do not establish that E2F8 causally accelerates disease or that suppressing it is beneficial.

records.title: Histone lactylation increases CXCL1 expression for neutrophil infiltration and immune escape in pancreatic cancer.
records.model: Subcutaneous and orthotopic pancreatic-tumor models
records.note: The combined treatment enhanced tumor control in models where lactate-associated histone modification promoted CXCL1, neutrophil recruitment and immunosuppression.
records.uncertainty: The demonstrated effect is antitumor activity; inhibitor specificity and general immune restoration require evidence beyond this abstract.

records.title: Examining the biomarkers and molecular mechanisms of medulloblastoma based on bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Four medulloblastoma expression datasets and independent survival profiles
records.note: Expression-network analysis nominated mitotic and replication hubs and pathways potentially associated with medulloblastoma biology.
records.uncertainty: No candidate therapy was tested and inferred mechanisms remain hypotheses.

records.title: Mice as a mammalian model for research on the genetics of aging.
records.model: Mouse genetics, lifespan-intervention programs and human/mouse locus comparisons
records.note: Reviews mouse resources for studying aging, calorie restriction and candidate lifespan genes, emphasizing opportunities for functional followup.
records.uncertainty: No particular administered treatment or quantitative lifespan benefit is stated.

records.title: Lactylation omics of rabbit rotator cuff tear reveals differentially modified proteins and metabolic relating therapy targets.
records.model: Rabbit rotator-cuff-tear protein lactylation profiling
records.note: The study mapped many lactylation sites and identified modified proteins and enriched pathways in injured rotator-cuff tissue.
records.uncertainty: Therapeutic intervention is a stated future aim; no muscle/tendon functional recovery is reported.

records.title: Age-Related Loss of Cohesion: Causes and Effects.
records.model: Age-related cohesin deterioration in female meiosis
records.note: Reviews loss of long-lived oocyte cohesion and its contribution to maternal-age-associated chromosome errors.
records.uncertainty: No intervention replenishing cohesion or reducing aneuploidy is described.

records.title: A centrosome-independent role for gamma-TuRC proteins in the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Gamma-tubulin-ring-complex and spindle-checkpoint experiments
records.note: Checkpoint competence required gamma-TuRC components but did not require their centrosomal localization or intact centrosomes.
records.uncertainty: The finding establishes a checkpoint requirement, without rescue or administered-drug evidence.

records.title: Molecular Subsets in Renal Cancer Determine Outcome to Checkpoint and Angiogenesis Blockade.
records.model: Advanced renal-cell-carcinoma patients with molecular profiling of 823 tumors
records.note: Both regimens benefited angiogenic tumor subsets, while the combination improved outcomes in subsets with high T-effector or cell-cycle expression.
records.uncertainty: This is clinical oncology stratification, not correction of inherited chromosome instability or nonmalignant tissue function.

records.title: The Lamin Proteins in Nuclear Structure, Functions, and Laminopathies.
records.model: Lamin function and laminopathy models including muscular dystrophy and premature aging
records.note: Reviews tissue-specific nuclear dysfunction and therapeutic developments including farnesyltransferase inhibition and genome editing.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not identify a specific regimen, measured recovery or applicability to another inherited disorder.

records.title: Ferroptosis: Opportunities and Challenges in Treating Endometrial Cancer.
records.model: Ferroptosis genes and therapeutic approaches in endometrial cancer
records.note: Surveys ferroptosis-associated biomarkers and agents intended to induce cancer-cell death.
records.uncertainty: No named administered intervention or nonmalignant restoration outcome is provided.

records.title: Common Core Genes Play Vital Roles in Gastric Cancer With Different Stages.
records.model: Gastric-cancer expression datasets stratified by stage and TCGA mutation information
records.note: Integrated analyses identified shared expression changes, low-ghrelin associations with adverse outcomes and candidate survival-related hubs.
records.uncertainty: Low ghrelin is an association; ghrelin supplementation or functional compensation was not tested.

records.title: Shifting the Cancer Screening Paradigm: The Rising Potential of Blood-Based Multi-Cancer Early Detection Tests.
records.model: Blood-based multi-cancer early-detection technologies
records.note: Summarizes molecular-marker and artificial-intelligence screening strategies and their clinical-validation gaps.
records.uncertainty: The topic is early detection, with no treatment or restoration evidence.

records.title: Comparative profiling identifies C13orf3 as a component of the Ska complex required for mammalian cell division.
records.model: Mammalian cells with C13orf3/Ska3 RNAi and protein-localization/proteomics analysis
records.note: Ska3 depletion triggered metaphase arrest, checkpoint activation and cohesion loss; localization and binding data placed it in the Ska complex with a PP2A interaction.
records.uncertainty: An essential mitotic function is shown, but no compensatory intervention is reported.

records.title: A pivot-tether model for nucleosome recognition by the chromosomal passenger complex.
records.model: Cryo-EM and functional characterization of passenger-complex binding to phosphorylated nucleosomes
records.note: A flexible survivin/borealin targeting arrangement increased nucleosome affinity and supported Aurora-B-dependent checkpoint signaling.
records.uncertainty: Structural insight does not demonstrate a restorative agent or disease correction.

records.title: Mining Database to Identify Aging-Related Molecular Subtype and Prognostic Signature in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: TCGA lung-adenocarcinoma aging-gene clustering and prognostic modeling
records.note: Aging-related expression signatures separated clinical and immune subgroups and correlated with inferred treatment sensitivity.
records.uncertainty: The abstract gives no prospective administration or improved aging phenotype.

records.title: E2F4 regulates a stable G2 arrest response to genotoxic stress in prostate carcinoma.
records.model: Irradiated prostate-carcinoma cells with E2F4 RNAi
records.note: E2F4/p130 supported a durable G2 arrest after irradiation, whereas E2F4 depletion increased damage, caspase activation and loss of clonogenic survival.
records.uncertainty: Radiation is the stressor and endogenous E2F4 is protective; no administered restoration agent was tested.

records.title: A Critical Review on the Effect of Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA) on Cancer Cell Cycle Progression.
records.model: DHA and cancer-cell-cycle literature
records.note: Critically reviews evidence that DHA stalls cancer-cell cycling and may enhance chemotherapy outcomes.
records.uncertainty: The benefits discussed concern cancer control; this abstract provides no direct functional-restoration experiment.

records.title: Cellular Senescence as the Causal Nexus of Aging.
records.model: Conceptual model connecting cellular damage, senescence and aging
records.note: Proposes senescence and its secretory phenotype as a convergence point translating diverse subcellular damage into tissue aging.
records.uncertainty: The claim is a conceptual synthesis, with no tested senolytic or tissue-restoration treatment.

records.title: KIFC1: a promising chemotherapy target for cancer treatment?
records.model: KIFC1 roles in tumors and specialized normal cell types
records.note: Reviews tumor-centrosome clustering as a rationale for KIFC1 targeting while acknowledging functions in gametes, embryos and trafficking.
records.uncertainty: Safety advantages are argued rather than demonstrated, and no actual inhibitor outcome is described.

records.title: L-methionine-induced alterations in molecular signatures in MCF-7 and LNCaP cancer cells.
records.model: MCF-7 breast-cancer and LNCaP prostate-cancer cells
records.note: Methionine altered redox- and kinase-related expression programs in both cancer lines, consistent with proposed antioxidant and antiproliferative mechanisms.
records.uncertainty: Antioxidant enhancement is inferred from gene expression; restored cell function was not directly demonstrated.

records.title: Inhibition of Akt/mTOR signaling by the dietary flavonoid fisetin.
records.model: Fisetin and PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling in cancer models
records.note: Reviews fisetin-associated suppression of oncogenic signaling and prior in vitro/in vivo anticancer findings.
records.uncertainty: This abstract does not report senolysis, muscle compensation or other restorative efficacy.

records.title: Bioinformatical analysis of gene expression signatures of different glioma subtypes.
records.model: Public astrocytoma, glioblastoma and oligodendroglioma expression profiles
