records.note: Comparative expression analysis identified common neural-signaling changes and subtype-associated cell-cycle or matrix programs.
records.uncertainty: The named genes and pathways are inferred disease candidates, without intervention experiments.

records.title: There's more to death than life: Noncatalytic functions in kinase and pseudokinase signaling.
records.model: Noncatalytic functions of kinases and pseudokinases
records.note: Reviews scaffolding, allostery and switching functions that can persist without kinase catalysis and considers small-molecule modulation.
records.uncertainty: No particular compound or disease-rescue outcome is given.

records.title: Chromosome instability and deregulated proliferation: an unavoidable duo.
records.model: Oncogenes/tumor suppressors linking proliferation and chromosome instability
records.note: Discusses how APC, p53, RB1 and Ras dysfunction connects growth control with genome maintenance.
records.uncertainty: Mechanistic review does not show a drug that restores either process.

records.title: Incorporating prior knowledge into Gene Network Study.
records.model: Simulation and cancer-expression applications of a prior-informed network-reconstruction method
records.note: A Bayesian Lasso formulation incorporated pathway knowledge to improve network recovery in simulations and identify clinical-outcome-associated hubs.
records.uncertainty: Network reconstruction accuracy is the endpoint, not biological restoration.

records.title: Protein phosphatase 4 plays dual roles during cell proliferation.
records.model: HepG2 cells with PP4 siRNA, phosphatase-dead expression or PP4 overexpression
records.note: Both PP4 increase and inhibition reduced proliferation; excess PP4 specifically disrupted alignment and spindle assembly, with SAF-A interactions implicated by proteomics and rescue experiments.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not detail the rescue manipulations or restored endpoints; a kinase/phosphatase activation strategy cannot assume monotonic benefit.

records.title: Structural Insight into Anaphase Promoting Complex 3 Structure and Docking with a Natural Inhibitory Compound.
records.model: Computational APC3 structural model and docking
records.note: Modeling described APC3 repeat-domain architecture and a putative pocket for an unnamed natural inhibitory compound.
records.uncertainty: There is no physical administration, verified inhibition, or cell-function outcome.

records.title: Maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 15 with concurrent paternal non-chromosome 15 marker chromosome: a rare presentation of prader-willi syndrome.
records.model: Prenatal cytogenetic case of Prader–Willi syndrome
records.note: Testing identified maternal chromosome-15 uniparental disomy together with an unrelated paternal marker chromosome.
records.uncertainty: This diagnostic report contains no therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Epigenetic mechanisms underlying the pathogenesis of neurogenetic diseases.
records.model: Genetic/epigenetic mechanisms and research tools in neurologic disease
records.note: Reviews interactions of genotype, epigenetic state and environmental context, along with emerging perturbation tools.
records.uncertainty: No specified epigenetic treatment or restoration outcome is reported.

records.title: Adaptive expansion of ERVK solo-LTRs is associated with Passeriformes speciation events.
records.model: Genomes of 362 bird species with regulatory experiments in bird models
records.note: ERVK solo-LTR accumulation correlated with passerine diversification and experimentally supported enhanced ITGA2 regulation in zebra finches.
records.uncertainty: Evolutionary cis-regulation is not an administered therapeutic or functional disease rescue.

records.title: Arginine Depletion in Human Cancers.
records.model: COSMIC mutation reanalysis and literature on arginine substitutions in cancer
records.note: The study attributes recurrent arginine substitutions to nucleotide-transition biases and selection, identifying affected driver genes.
records.uncertainty: Despite the title, this abstract concerns depletion of arginine residues through mutation, not dietary or drug-induced arginine depletion therapy.

records.title: Analysis of gene expression profile for identification of novel gene signatures during dengue infection.
records.model: Public dengue and severe-dengue expression datasets
records.note: Meta-analysis identified cyclin and innate/adaptive immune expression signatures associated with dengue infection and severity categories.
records.uncertainty: Candidate drug targets are inferred; no antiviral or restorative treatment was administered.

records.title: Senotherapeutics to Counteract Senescent Cells Are Prominent Topics in the Context of Anti-Ageing Strategies.
records.model: Senescent-cell targeting and anti-aging strategy literature
records.note: Reviews senolytic, senomorphic and immune-mediated clearance concepts linked to inflammatory aging and tissue decline.
records.uncertainty: No individual intervention, dose or measured functional improvement is specified in the abstract.

records.title: A comprehensive analysis of candidate genes in familial pancreatic cancer families reveals a high frequency of potentially pathogenic germline variants.
records.model: Cancer-gene panels in 43 pancreatic-cancer cases from suspected hereditary families
records.note: Sequencing detected pathogenic variants in a subset of families and additional low-frequency variants of uncertain significance, suggesting genetic heterogeneity.
records.uncertainty: Uncertain variants are not proven causal, and no genotype-directed therapy was tested.

records.title: Characterization of the Survival Influential Genes in Carcinogenesis.
records.model: Survival modeling in more than 6000 tumors across 16 cancer types
records.note: Cell-cycle modules often correlated with worse survival, while protective expression modules varied and commonly involved immunity.
records.uncertainty: Harmful/protective labels refer to statistical prognosis associations, not interventional causal effects.

records.title: Delayed Signaling in Mitotic Checkpoints: Biological Mechanisms and Modeling Perspectives.
records.model: Biological delays and differential-equation models of mitotic checkpoints
records.note: Reviews how transport, activation and mechanical delays shape checkpoint timing, arrest and silencing.
records.uncertainty: Modeling perspectives do not identify a validated drug or repaired division outcome.

records.title: Aurora-A expression is independently associated with chromosomal instability in colorectal cancer.
records.model: AURKA immunostaining and molecular analyses in 517 colorectal tumors
records.note: AURKA overexpression independently associated with loss-of-heterozygosity-defined chromosome instability, but not with survival in this analysis.
records.uncertainty: CIN was operationalized by selected LOH regions rather than directly measured error rates; no inhibitor was tested.

records.title: Viral transformation and aneuploidy.
records.model: Viral oncoproteins and cellular aneuploidy
records.note: Reviews viral disruption of checkpoint, centrosome and cytokinesis mechanisms as a route to abnormal chromosome number.
records.uncertainty: No antiviral or checkpoint-restoring treatment is reported.

records.title: Combined analysis of murine and human microarrays and ChIP analysis reveals genes associated with the ability of MYC to maintain tumorigenesis.
records.model: MYC-regulated mouse tumor models with comparison to human lymphoma expression datasets
records.note: Brief MYC inactivation produced durable changes in expression and promoter binding associated with sustained tumor regression, yielding a tumor-maintenance signature.
records.uncertainty: This is oncogene withdrawal and tumor biology; the inactivation modality and a restorative drug are not specified.

records.title: HypoxamiR regulation and function in ischemic cardiovascular diseases.
records.model: Hypoxia-responsive microRNAs in ischemic cardiovascular disease
records.note: Reviews context-dependent roles of hypoxia-induced miRNAs, especially miR-210, and motivates future therapeutic development.
records.uncertainty: No administered miRNA treatment or improved ischemic function is stated.

records.title: Shugoshin-1 balances Aurora B kinase activity via PP2A to promote chromosome bi-orientation.
records.model: Nontransformed RPE-1 cells with altered centromeric Sgo1
records.note: Sgo1 elevation recruited excess PP2A-B56 and suppressed Aurora B enough to impair attachment-error correction; depletion reduced both factors while making remaining Aurora B hyperactive.
records.uncertainty: This is dosage-sensitive genetic localization biology, not a drug trial, but cautions against assuming more PP2A recruitment always improves fidelity.

records.title: Gene expression profiling spares early breast cancer patients from adjuvant therapy: derived and validated in two population-based cohorts.
records.model: Population-derived breast-cancer cohorts with expression profiles and treatment/outcome histories
records.note: A 64-gene signature separated favorable and poor outcome groups among treated and untreated cohorts and was externally validated.
records.uncertainty: Specific administered regimens are unnamed and the analysis does not demonstrate prospective safe omission of therapy.

records.title: Inhibitor-3 ensures bipolar mitotic spindle attachment by limiting association of SDS22 with kinetochore-bound protein phosphatase-1.
records.model: Cells depleted of endogenous inhibitor-3 and analyzed for kinetochore PP1/SDS22 signaling
records.note: Loss of inhibitor-3 trapped SDS22 with kinetochore PP1, weakened Aurora-B dephosphorylation and produced persistent Aurora-B activity with segregation errors.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor-3 is a regulatory protein, not an administered drug; no rescue intervention is specified.

records.title: A maternal effect rough deal mutation suggests that multiple pathways regulate Drosophila RZZ kinetochore recruitment.
records.model: Drosophila maternal-effect rod mutant embryos and larval neuroblasts
records.note: The same Rod mutation eliminated early-embryo RZZ recruitment and checkpoint function but had milder effects in larval neuroblasts, indicating developmental differences in recruitment.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic manipulation or rescue is reported.

records.title: Motor-independent targeting of CLASPs to kinetochores by CENP-E promotes microtubule turnover and poleward flux.
records.model: Human cells with CENP-E/CLASP RNAi and Kif2a depletion
records.note: CENP-E recruited CLASPs independently of motor activity; depleting either lowered microtubule flux/turnover and restored spindle bipolarity in Kif2a-depleted cells.
records.uncertainty: Restored bipolar geometry does not alone prove corrected chromosome segregation; the rescue was genetic, not a CENP-E drug.

records.title: Arsenic hexoxide has differential effects on cell proliferation and genome-wide gene expression in human primary mammary epithelial and MCF7 cells.
records.model: MCF7 breast-cancer cells and primary human mammary epithelial controls
records.note: Arsenic hexoxide arrested and killed MCF7 cells while sparing control-cell growth at tested exposures, with suppressed repair/cycle programs and increased stress responses.
records.uncertainty: Selectivity in these cell models does not establish systemic safety, and increased tumor genome instability is an intended cytotoxic mechanism rather than restoration.

records.title: A computational approach to identifying gene-microRNA modules in cancer.
records.model: Ovarian-cancer and glioblastoma gene/miRNA datasets
records.note: A network method combined sample-specific gene modules with inferred miRNA relationships and recovered many cancer-associated pathways.
records.uncertainty: Validation is computational enrichment; no therapeutic intervention or functional recovery was tested.

records.title: Investigation of differentially expressed genes in nasopharyngeal carcinoma by integrated bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Two nasopharyngeal-carcinoma expression datasets
records.note: Integrated profiles identified ciliary, mitotic and viral-infection-associated pathways and candidate hubs for further study.
records.uncertainty: No gene correction or administered treatment was tested.

records.title: PLK4 Is a Potential Biomarker for Abnormal Tumor Proliferation, Immune Infiltration, and Prognosis in ccRCC.
records.model: Clear-cell renal-cancer databases with miR-214-3p/PLK4 expression experiments
records.note: Higher PLK4 associated with low methylation, poor prognosis and immune features; expression assays supported negative regulation by miR-214-3p.
records.uncertainty: No PLK4 inhibitor or functional restoration endpoint is presented.

records.title: RCL1 copy number variants are associated with a range of neuropsychiatric phenotypes.
records.model: An adolescent psychiatric case and eleven additional RCL1 copy-number cases
records.note: A stop-gain variant and dosage changes in RCL1 were associated with diverse developmental or psychiatric phenotypes.
records.uncertainty: The case series suggests gene involvement but reports no targeted treatment or rescue.

records.title: Integrated bioinformatics analysis to identify 15 hub genes in breast cancer.
records.model: GEO and TCGA breast-cancer expression and survival datasets
records.note: Intersecting network analyses yielded 15 hub genes whose higher expression associated with shorter survival.
records.uncertainty: The findings nominate markers rather than demonstrate disease mechanisms or drug efficacy.

records.title: Enhanced levels of double-strand DNA break repair proteins protect ovarian cancer cells against genotoxic stress-induced apoptosis.
records.model: Serous ovarian-cancer progression model and repair-protein silencing studies
records.note: RAD50, NPM1 and XRCC5 were elevated in transformed cells and damage responses; their silencing compromised repair and promoted instability and p53/p21-associated apoptosis.
records.uncertainty: The drugs were experimental stress/modulation contexts; the study does not show an administered agent restoring damaged normal cells.

records.title: PRMT1 inhibition perturbs RNA metabolism and induces DNA damage in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
records.model: Clear-cell renal-carcinoma models with PRMT1 genetic validation
records.note: MS023 and PRMT1 loss disrupted RNA metabolism, increased R-loops and accumulated DNA damage, with impaired growth and repair pathways.
records.uncertainty: The benefit is antitumor growth inhibition through damage, not genomic-fidelity restoration.

records.title: Genome-wide copy number analyses of samples from LACE-Bio project identify novel prognostic and predictive markers in early stage non-small cell lung cancer.
records.model: Tumors from randomized adjuvant-chemotherapy trials in resected lung cancer
records.note: Copy-number profiles associated selected regions and chromosomal instability with disease-free and cancer-specific survival.
records.uncertainty: Specific chemotherapy agents are unnamed, and the presented results are biomarker associations rather than demonstrated treatment-by-marker benefit.

records.title: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma in the era of precision medicine.
records.model: Precision-medicine approaches for pancreatic adenocarcinoma
records.note: Reviews biomarker-selected treatments, stromal/immune approaches and continuing resistance challenges in pancreatic cancer.
records.uncertainty: No new administered regimen or noncancer restorative outcome is reported in the abstract.

records.title: Killing cancer with platycodin D through multiple mechanisms.
records.model: Platycodin D anticancer mechanisms
records.note: Reviews apoptosis, cell-cycle arrest, autophagy and inhibition of invasion/angiogenesis as candidate anticancer actions of platycodin D.
records.uncertainty: Other protective activities are background claims without specific functional data here; no direct restoration experiment is reported.

records.title: Extracellular matrix proteins refine microenvironments for pancreatic organogenesis from induced pluripotent stem cell differentiation.
records.model: Human iPSC-derived pancreatic islet organoids informed by porcine and rat matrix proteomics
records.note: Collagen-II cues promoted endocrine progenitor and islet formation and improved glucose-sensitive hormone secretion, alongside differentiation-associated expression changes.
records.uncertainty: This is an in vitro matrix-supported organoid strategy, not systemic drug efficacy or inherited-disease correction; exact contributions of collagen V require primary inspection.

records.title: Uncovering Potential Roles of Differentially Expressed Genes, Upstream Regulators, and Canonical Pathways in Endometriosis Using an In Silico Genomics Approach.
records.model: Endometriosis transcriptomic meta-analysis of 156 cases and 118 controls
records.note: Expression and pathway analyses highlighted inflammatory regulators and mitotic/checkpoint pathways as disease-associated candidates.
records.uncertainty: The observational expression analysis does not establish causative genes or tested therapeutic effects.

records.title: Naturally derived indole alkaloids targeting regulated cell death (RCD) for cancer therapy: from molecular mechanisms to potential therapeutic targets.
records.model: Natural indole alkaloids and regulated cancer-cell death literature
records.note: Reviews alkaloid-associated apoptosis and other death pathways, including combination oncology strategies.
records.uncertainty: Named compounds are literature examples, not agents administered in a new restoration experiment.

records.title: The Effects and Underlying Mechanisms of Hepatitis B Virus X Gene Mutants on the Development of Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: HBx-mutant mouse models and HepG2/HeLa cells
records.note: Selected viral mutants increased tumors and proliferation; PAI1 silencing attenuated mutant-associated cellular growth effects.
records.uncertainty: The genetic suppression targets oncogenic expansion and does not show a pharmacologic or tissue-function rescue.

records.title: Up-regulation of microRNA-210 inhibits proliferation of hepatocellular carcinoma cells by targeting YES1.
records.model: HepG2/HuH7 cancer cells and 21 paired liver-tumor samples
records.note: miR-210 overexpression lowered YES1 and slowed cancer-cell cycling; inhibiting the miRNA prevented nocodazole-associated YES1 reduction, while YES1 knockdown also reduced proliferation.
records.uncertainty: Restoring a protein level under cell-cycle arrest is not demonstrated restored division fidelity or tissue function.

records.title: Ubiquitylation-dependent localization of PLK1 in mitosis.
records.model: KLHL22 loss and nonubiquitylatable PLK1 mutants during mitosis
records.note: CUL3–KLHL22 ubiquitylation removed PLK1 from kinetochores without degrading it; impaired removal caused excess localization and checkpoint activation.
records.uncertainty: No pharmacologic correction or explicit rescue is reported.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint robustness requires Tpr-mediated regulation of Mad1/Mad2 proteostasis.
records.model: Tpr-depleted cells with GFP-Mad2 overexpression
records.note: Tpr stabilized Mad1/Mad2 before mitosis, and GFP-Mad2 overexpression restored kinetochore Mad2 levels and a normal checkpoint response after Tpr loss.
records.uncertainty: The rescue is protein overexpression in a specific depletion model, not drug-mediated correction or proof of long-term segregation fidelity.

records.title: Sds22 regulates aurora B activity and microtubule-kinetochore interactions at mitosis.
records.model: Cells depleted of Sds22 during mitosis
records.note: Sds22 loss changed PP1 localization, elevated kinetochore Aurora-B phosphorylation and altered microtubule binding/force relationships; recovery from monastrol arrest was faster.
records.uncertainty: Faster arrest recovery is not shown to improve fidelity; monastrol is the challenge, not a protective intervention.

records.title: Transcriptional Dynamics of Immortalized Human Mesenchymal Stem Cells during Transformation.
records.model: Immortalized human mesenchymal stem-cell transformation series and mouse tumorigenicity assays
records.note: Progressive aneuploidy and expression changes accompanied transformation, with GPC5 depletion reducing transformed-cell proliferation.
records.uncertainty: Immortalization and tumor growth inhibition do not constitute regenerative stem-cell restoration.

records.title: Network Embedding the Protein-Protein Interaction Network for Human Essential Genes Identification.
records.model: Human protein-interaction datasets and supervised essential-gene prediction
records.note: Network embeddings improved prediction of known essential genes relative to several sequence or topology-based alternatives.
records.uncertainty: Predictive performance does not demonstrate functional gene rescue or a therapy.

records.title: Transcription in the maintenance of centromere chromatin identity.
records.model: Centromeric/pericentromeric transcription and chromatin maintenance
records.note: Reviews controlled transcription as a contributor to CENP-A domain assembly and centromeric identity, while noting uncertain cancer effects of excess transcripts.
records.uncertainty: No therapeutic transcript manipulation or restored segregation outcome is specified.

records.title: Prevalence of Germline Mutations Associated With Cancer Risk in Patients With Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasms.
records.model: Sequencing of 94 cancer-risk genes in 315 resected pancreatic IPMN cases
records.note: Germline susceptibility variants occurred in a minority of patients and associated with concurrent invasive carcinoma.
records.uncertainty: The proposed application is risk identification, without intervention efficacy.

records.title: Astrocyte senescence: Evidence and significance.
records.model: Astrocyte senescence and neurodegeneration literature
records.note: Reviews loss of astrocyte support and increased inflammation as potential links between aging and neurologic decline.
records.uncertainty: Targeting senescent astrocytes is proposed, but no named treatment or measured recovery is reported.

records.title: To detect potential pathways and target genes in infantile Pompe patients using computational analysis.

administered_agents.name: recombinant human acid alpha-glucosidase
administered_agents.role: enzyme-replacement exposure in the analyzed source cohort

records.model: Public biceps/quadriceps transcriptomes from infantile Pompe disease with ERT-response groups
records.note: Reanalysis linked poor enzyme-replacement response to actin, lysosomal, inflammatory and WNT expression changes and proposed candidate response markers.
records.uncertainty: This is secondary transcriptomic analysis, not a new compensatory intervention; differing muscles and treatment groups limit causal attribution from the abstract.

records.title: Exploration of the molecular mechanisms of cervical cancer based on mRNA expression profiles and predicted microRNA interactions.
records.model: Cervical-cancer and normal-tissue expression profiles with predicted miRNA interactions
records.note: A 16-gene regulatory subset distinguished tumor samples and survival-risk groups, implicating cell-cycle and developmental programs.
records.uncertainty: The inferred mechanisms and miRNA links were not tested as restorative treatments.

records.title: Hurp deficiency in mice leads to female infertility caused by an implantation defect.
records.model: Hurp-knockout mice and uterine biology experiments
records.note: Female knockout mice failed to implant despite normal early reproductive stages because endometrial stromal proliferation and decidualization were defective; estrogen induced uterine HURP expression.
records.uncertainty: Estrogen-induced expression is not shown to rescue knockout fertility or implantation.

records.title: The chromosomal challenge of human embryos: Mechanisms and fundamentals.
records.model: Human oocyte and preimplantation-embryo chromosome errors
records.note: Reviews distinct meiotic and postfertilization sources of aneuploidy, including cohesion, kinetochore, centrosome and maternal-factor defects.
records.uncertainty: The authors state that relative mechanistic contributions remain uncertain; no intervention is tested.

records.title: Transcriptome analysis of mesenteric arterioles changes and its mechanisms in cirrhotic rats with portal hypertension.
records.model: Bile-duct-ligated cirrhotic rats with mesenteric-arteriole physiology and transcriptomics
records.note: Cirrhosis produced vasodilation, remodeling and poor contractility; pathway and hub analyses proposed compounds such as resveratrol for future amelioration.
records.uncertainty: Resveratrol was predicted, not administered, and no reversal of vascular dysfunction was demonstrated.

records.title: Genotoxic Effect of Salmonella Paratyphi A Infection on Human Primary Gallbladder Cells.
records.model: Healthy human gallbladder-derived organoids and polarized epithelial monolayers
records.note: Infection caused CdtB-dependent DNA breaks in infected and neighboring cells, while some intoxicated uninfected cells continued proliferating despite damage.
records.uncertainty: This is an injury mechanism, not evidence that an antibiotic or other treatment restores genomic integrity.

records.title: Kinetochore stretching inactivates the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Fluorescently labeled HeLa kinetochores with mechanical-stretch perturbation
records.note: Suppressing intrakinetochore stretch delayed checkpoint silencing and cyclin-B degradation even when centromere stretch differed, supporting a local mechanical readout.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not specify an administered therapeutic or disease rescue.

records.title: Mammalian CLASP1 and CLASP2 cooperate to ensure mitotic fidelity by regulating spindle and kinetochore function.
records.model: Primary fibroblasts from Clasp2-knockout mice with ectopic Clasp expression
records.note: Clasp2 loss caused chromosome/spindle defects despite preserved proliferation and checkpoint signaling; either Clasp1 or Clasp2 expression partially rescued the defects.
records.uncertainty: The evidence supports genetic paralog compensation, with no drug that increases CLASP function tested.

records.title: Mitotic DNA Damage Response: At the Crossroads of Structural and Numerical Cancer Chromosome Instabilities.
records.model: DNA-damage signaling during mitosis in normal and cancer cells
records.note: Discusses protective mitotic damage responses and how inappropriate activation can itself promote chromosome-segregation errors in cancer.
records.uncertainty: The abstract offers no specific corrective agent; increased damage signaling should not automatically be equated with improved fidelity.

records.title: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Perspectives of Gut Microbiota, Autophagy, and Apoptosis in Cholangiocarcinoma Pathophysiology.
records.model: Gut microbiota, autophagy and apoptosis in cholangiocarcinoma
records.note: Reviews strain-dependent microbial effects and proposes microbiome modulation for improved tumor immunity and biliary homeostasis.
records.uncertainty: No specified probiotic or dietary regimen with demonstrated restorative efficacy is reported.

records.title: Identification of castration-dependent and -independent driver genes and pathways in castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC).
records.model: Castrated-rat epididymis profiles compared with prostate-cancer expression datasets
records.note: Cross-dataset analysis separated castration-shared from resistant-cancer-specific expression changes and nominated NUSAP1/NCAPG.
records.uncertainty: Surgical androgen removal is the perturbation; the abstract does not test a compensatory drug or prove driver causality.

records.title: Transcription factor positive regulatory domain 4 (PRDM4) recruits protein arginine methyltransferase 5 (PRMT5) to mediate histone arginine methylation and control neural stem cell proliferation and differentiation.
records.model: Embryonic cortical neural stem cells with PRDM4/SC1 expression perturbations
records.note: SC1 recruited PRMT5, increased Nestin-positive precursor abundance when overexpressed, and delayed differentiation; depletion caused premature neuronal differentiation.
records.uncertainty: More precursor markers do not establish repaired neural function or a therapeutic benefit, and no PRMT5 drug was tested.

records.title: Oxidative stress-induced premature senescence dysregulates VEGF and CFH expression in retinal pigment epithelial cells: Implications for Age-related Macular Degeneration.
records.model: ARPE-19 human retinal pigment epithelial cells
records.note: N-acetylcysteine reduced senescence markers in cigarette-smoke-exposed cells; separate senescent cultures showed inflammatory cytokine increases and altered VEGF/CFH expression.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not establish that NAC normalized VEGF/CFH, restored retinal function or treated inherited checkpoint deficiency.

records.title: EBNA3C regulates p53 through induction of Aurora kinase B.
records.model: EBV-infected primary cells and EBNA3C/Aurora-B/p53 perturbations
records.note: EBNA3C induced Aurora B and altered p53/p73 regulation; kinase and substrate mutations mapped key interactions, and Aurora-B knockdown increased p73.
records.uncertainty: Protein-expression reversal is not shown to restore normal division or tissue function, and no kinase drug is specified.

records.title: Local endoreduplication of the host is a conserved process during Phytomyxea-host interaction
records.model: Phytomyxea-infected plants and brown algae with ploidy and RNA profiling
records.note: Parasitic infection promoted host endoreduplication across distant plant/algal hosts, with cell-cycle-switch regulators implicated by expression.
records.uncertainty: This is a preprint infection mechanism, not pharmacologic or regenerative compensation.

records.title: Impact of NGS in the medical sciences: Genetic syndromes with an increased risk of developing cancer as an example of the use of new technologies.
records.model: Sequencing technologies for developmental syndromes with elevated cancer risk
records.note: Reviews how genomic testing links congenital syndromes and cancer susceptibility and supports diagnostic gene panels.
records.uncertainty: No targeted therapy or functional restoration is reported.

records.title: Yeast as a Model to Unravel New BRCA2 Functions in Cell Metabolism.
records.model: Yeast expressing BRCA2 during growth or regulated-cell-death conditions
records.note: Transcriptome comparisons suggested that BRCA2 modifies central carbon metabolism during death responses, motivating a multifunctional stress-response model.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not quantify improved survival or show an administered metabolic rescue.

records.title: An individualized gene expression signature for prediction of lung adenocarcinoma metastases.
records.model: TCGA lung-adenocarcinoma RNA-seq data validating a nine-gene-pair prognostic signature
records.note: The signature stratified early-stage survival and metastatic-status enrichment; modified classification sharpened associated genomic/expression patterns.
records.uncertainty: Predicted occult metastasis is not interventional prevention or treatment benefit.

records.title: CENPA regulates tumor stemness in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Lung-adenocarcinoma stemness scores, coexpression analysis and risk modeling
records.note: Network and risk-gene intersections nominated CENPA as a stemness-associated prognostic factor.
records.uncertainty: The abstract says CENPA was validated but does not describe an intervention or functional effect sufficiently to infer rescue.

records.title: Nicotinic alpha 7 receptor expression and modulation of the lung epithelial response to lipopolysaccharide.
records.model: Mice with alpha7 nicotinic-receptor calcium-signaling mutation and lung epithelial profiling
records.note: The receptor mutation reduced some inflammatory transcripts yet also reduced ciliated-cell abundance and produced mucin/ECM abnormalities, demonstrating context-dependent epithelial effects.
records.uncertainty: Nicotine is background context, not a reported administered treatment here; lower cytokines alone do not establish improved lung function.

records.title: Clinically relevant stratification of lung squamous carcinoma patients based on ubiquitinated proteasome genes for 3P medical approach.
records.model: Lung squamous-carcinoma proteasome-gene expression and immune/prognostic analyses
records.note: Proteasome-based signatures stratified survival and immune states, with PSMD11 implicated in tumor progression.
records.uncertainty: Proteasome-inhibitor discussion is rationale; no named administration or restored tissue endpoint is provided.

records.title: Key players in chromosome segregation in Caenorhabditis elegans.
records.model: Caenorhabditis elegans chromosome segregation and checkpoint proteins
records.note: Compares conserved and distinctive kinetochore, cohesion and checkpoint functions in a holocentric organism.
records.uncertainty: No administered treatment or rescue experiment is specified.

records.title: Weighted gene co-expression network analysis reveals modules and hub genes associated with the development of breast cancer.
records.model: Breast-cancer progression expression datasets with Oncomine corroboration
records.note: Coexpression modules linked migration, cycling and adhesion to progression, with several candidate hubs elevated in tumors.
records.uncertainty: The inferred biomarkers and target suggestions lack intervention evidence.

records.title: Ketamine-induced neurotoxicity and changes in gene expression in the developing rat brain.
records.model: Postnatal-day-7 rat pups
records.note: Six 20 mg/kg ketamine injections increased cortical neuronal death and NMDA-receptor expression; lower exposures did not show statistically significant death in this experiment.
records.uncertainty: This developmental repeated-dose model does not establish human clinical risk at other regimens, and absence of significance at lower exposure is not proof of no effect.

records.title: Removal of Spindly from microtubule-attached kinetochores controls spindle checkpoint silencing in human cells.
records.model: Human cells with Spindly depletion and dynein-recruitment-defective Spindly mutants
records.note: Spindly mutants improved the alignment delay caused by depletion but remained at attached kinetochores and sustained checkpoint signaling, separating alignment from checkpoint silencing.
records.uncertainty: The genetic rescue is incomplete and produces another mitotic defect; no administered agent or net fidelity benefit was shown.

records.title: The miR-8/miR-200 family: from functional diversification to translational applications.
records.model: Evolution and translational roles of the miR-8/miR-200 family
records.note: Reviews conserved and lineage-specific regulation of differentiation, immunity, cancer and metabolism, with delivery specificity and pleiotropy remaining challenges.
records.uncertainty: Potential clinical/agricultural applications are proposals rather than demonstrated restoration treatments.
